1000008.name: Windbloom
1000008.desc: When Velina enters the battlefield, she gains 45 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbloom</color>. Using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Purifying Rise</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Triple Deathblow</color> grants 45 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbloom</color>, up to a maximum of 135 points. With enough <color=#FFFFFF>Windbloom</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> or <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to launch <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Eye of the Storm</color>.

1000009.name: Top Hat Companion
1000009.desc:
When using <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Hat Trick</color>, the thrown hat:
Is actually a Bangboo. While Top Hat Companion is on the field, it accumulates Preheated Chamber in Norma's place. When Norma retrieves the Top Hat Companion, all accumulated Preheated Chamber is transferred to her.
Top Hat Companion inherits all of Norma's stats.

1000010.name: En-Nah Turret
1000010.desc:
The white turret summoned by <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: En-Nah Barrage</color>:
Automatically uses Special Attack: Target Practice at regular intervals. After deploying its missile bay, this skill is replaced with EX Special Attack: Explosive Experiment.
En-Nah Turrets inherit all of Norma's stats.

1000011.name: Preheated Chamber
1000011.desc:
While Norma or her Top Hat Companion is on the field, gain 1.5% Preheated Chamber per second.
When Preheated Chamber reaches 80% or higher, the Quick Assist triggered by Basic Attack: Hat Trick is <color=#FFFFFF>replaced with a Chain Attack</color>.

1000012.name: En-Nah Barrage
1000012.desc:
The buff gained from <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: En-Nah Barrage</color>:
During its active duration, two En-Nah Turrets are summoned to fight alongside Norma.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Additional Ability: Advantage in Numbers</color> is triggered, Norma's ATK is further increased, and all squad members deal increased DMG.

1000013.name: Tech Divide
1000013.desc:
The debuff applied when Norma or her creations hit an enemy:
For the duration of the effect, the target's Stun DMG Multiplier is increased, and the duration of its Stunned state is extended.

1000014.name: Windbite
1000014.desc: When Velina triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color>, she gains 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbite</color>. When Velina has 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbite</color>, the next time she triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color>, she consumes 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbite</color> to increase that instance's DMG Multiplier.

1000015.name: Condensed Cyclone
1000015.desc: When Velina triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color>, she summons a <color=#FFFFFF>Condensed Cyclone</color> that deals <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>. When the <color=#FFFFFF>Condensed Cyclone</color> dissipates, it triggers an explosion. If the explosion hits an enemy afflicted with a <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Anomaly</color>, it deals one instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG.

1000016.name: Sweeping Cyclone
1000016.desc: When Velina uses <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Eye of the Storm</color> or triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color> while consuming 2 points of <Term:1000014>Windbite</Term>, she summons a <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> to continuously deal <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color> that is capable of triggering the <Term:1000017>Chromatic Tint</Term> effect. When <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> attacks hit enemies, the enemy's <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Anomaly Buildup RES</color> and the corresponding <color=#FFFFFF>Attribute Anomaly Buildup RES</color> from <color=#FFFFFF>Chromatic Tint</color> are reduced. When <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> dissipates, it triggers an explosion. If the explosion hits an enemy suffering a <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Anomaly</color>, it deals one instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG.

1000017.name: Chromatic Tint
1000017.desc: When <Term:1000016>Sweeping Cyclone</Term> hits an enemy afflicted with <color=#FFFFFF>Contamination</color> for the first time, it triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Chromatic Tint</color> effect, converting into a <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> of the corresponding attribute and dealing the corresponding attribute's DMG.

1000018.name: Solar Prominence
1000018.desc:
Upon entering the battlefield, Pyrois gains 30 <color=#FFFFFF>Solar Prominence</color>. Different attacks grant a certain amount of <color=#FFFFFF>Solar Prominence</color> when they hit enemies, and Pyrois also gains a certain amount of <color=#FFFFFF>Solar Prominence</color> every second.
With 30 or more Solar Prominence, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate Basic Attack: Celestial Light. Each hit from Basic Attack: Celestial Light consumes a certain amount of Solar Prominence.

1000019.name: Mirage
1000019.desc: Pyrois enters the Mirage state when using Ultimate: Total Annihilation. While in the Mirage state, Pyrois' Ultimate deals increased CRIT DMG against Stunned enemies.

1000020.name: Sunflare
1000020.desc: Pyrois enters the Sunflare state when using Ultimate: Triumphant Return. While Sunflare is active, Energy Generation Rate and DMG dealt increase, and triggering a Perfect Block with an EX Special Attack restores additional <Term:1000018></Term>.

1000021.name: Totalize
1000021.desc:
Grants a special effect against Stunned enemies.
When Pyrois triggers Totalize, additional DMG is dealt, and the target's Stunned state ends.

1000022.name: Cinderfire
1000022.desc: Gain Cinderfire when using a Chain Attack. All Cinderfire stacks are consumed upon using an Ultimate, granting a certain amount of <color=#FFFFFF>Decibels</color> for each stack consumed.

1000023.name: Anomaly Effect Strength
1000023.desc:
When applying Attribute Anomaly Buildup to an enemy, each attack's ATK, PEN, Anomaly Proficiency, DMG Bonus, and other effects proportionally increase the resulting <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly Effect Strength</color> based on that attack's contribution to the total Attribute Anomaly Buildup.
PEN effects: Includes PEN and PEN Ratio
DMG Bonus: Includes both non-Attribute DMG Bonus and Attribute DMG Bonus

1000024.name: Purr Energy
1000024.desc:
Nekomata gains 40 Purr Energy upon entering the battlefield. She recovers 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Purr Energy</color> every second, and different skills restore different amounts of Purr Energy on hit.
When Purr Energy is at least 40, press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> after triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to consume 30 Purr Energy and activate Dodge: Disappearing Tail.
When Purr Energy is at least 40, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to consume 40 Purr Energy and directly activate Dodge Counter: Fluffy Piercing Claw.

1000025.name: Pawpad Ambush
1000025.desc:
Nekomata enters Pawpad Ambush state for 40s after using Dodge Counter: Fluffy Piercing Claw. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
While Pawpad Ambush is active, all of Nekomata's attacks count as hitting from behind and trigger Super Mean Pawprint, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> equal to 30% of Nekomata's ATK. This effect can trigger once every 1s.

1000026.name: Fright
1000026.desc: While <color=#FFFFFF><Term:1000027></Term></color> is active, each activation of Drusilla or Anastella's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Morning Cleanup</color> grants 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Fright</color>. Upon reaching 6 stacks, the next <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Morning Cleanup</color> consumes all <color=#FFFFFF>Fright</color> stacks and is replaced with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Midnight Cleanup</color>.

1000027.name: Spotless
1000027.desc: While this is active, Drusilla or Anastella automatically uses <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Morning Cleanup</color> to attack enemies and gain <color=#FFFFFF><Term:1000026></Term></color>. After using the skill, Drusilla and Anastella's exit timer resets.

1000028.name: Formation Breaker
1000028.desc:
When <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Encroaching Ice</color> hits a Stunned elite or boss enemy for the first time, Sigrid enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Formation Breaker</color> state.
While in <color=#FFFFFF>Formation Breaker</color> state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to continuously use the 1st through 3rd stages of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>.

1000029.name: Unbridled Spear
1000029.desc:
The 4th hit of the <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> are considered <color=#FFFFFF>Unbridled Spear</color> skills.
When Sigrid hits an enemy with any <color=#FFFFFF>Unbridled Spear</color>, if she is not currently in the <Term:1000030></Term> state, she enters the <Term:1000030></Term> state and gains 1 activation of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>, up to 1 activation can be stored.

1000030.name: Aerial Patrol Spear
1000030.desc: While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Aerial Patrol Spear</color> state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to use <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>. When Sigrid uses any <Term:1000029></Term>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Aerial Patrol Spear</color> state is refreshed, and she gains 1 activation of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>. Up to 1 activation can be stored.

1000031.name: Refringe
1000031.desc: If an enemy has <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux Buildup</color>, when they're about to be inflicted with an Anomaly, that Anomaly is <color=#FFA9DD>Refringed</color>. After being <color=#FFA9DD>Refringed</color>, the Anomaly's <Term:1000023></Term> is enhanced based on the provider's <color=#FFA9DD>Refringe Coefficient</color>, increasing the total DMG that Anomaly can deal.

1000032.name: Floating Radiance
1000032.desc:
Remielle can gain <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> through <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> reaches its maximum of 120, Remielle can enter the <Term:1000035></Term> state.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state, <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> is consumed over time. When <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> is fully consumed, Remielle exits the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state.

1000033.name: Voidflare
1000033.desc: When a squad member triggers Remielle's <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux</color> <Term:1000031></Term> reaction, Remielle generates <color=#FFFFFF>Voidflare</color> based on the enhanced <Term:1000023></Term> of that Attribute Anomaly after it has been <color=#FFA9DD>Refringed</color>. Up to the 3 most recently generated <color=#FFFFFF>Voidflares</color> can be stored.

1000034.name: Luminize
1000034.desc: Deals Attribute Anomaly DMG to enemies using the skill's DMG Multiplier, based on the <Term:1000023></Term> of all stored <Term:1000033></Term>.

1000035.name: Phase Flow
1000035.desc: While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state, Remielle acts autonomously to assist in combat. During this, some attacks can also apply <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux Buildup</color> to the target. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state, <Term:1000032></Term> is consumed over time. When <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> is fully depleted, she exits the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state. Before exiting the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state, she cannot be actively switched in except through <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attacks</color>.

2000001.name: Corruptive Barrier
2000001.desc:
· <color=#FFAF2C>CRIT DMG RES, ATK, and Anti-Interrupt</color> are increased while all Agents in the squad lose HP over time.
· When the Corruptive Barrier is broken, a portion of HP is converted into HP for all Agents in the squad, and Energy is restored.

2000002.name: Miasmic Shield
2000002.desc:
· <color=#FFAF2C>DEF, DMG reduction</color>, and <color=#FFAF2C>Anti-Interrupt</color> are significantly enhanced, and the enemy will not be Stunned. Agents can deplete the Miasmic Shield through attacks.
· When the Miasmic Shield is broken, enemies take <color=#FFAF2C>Purify</color> DMG, and Agents <color=#FFAF2C>recover Energy or Adrenaline</color>.

2000003.name: Control Skill
2000003.desc:
· Skills <color=#FFAF2C>ignore the Invulnerable effect</color> and have no flash prompts. Agents cannot activate their Ultimates during this time. Only one Agent switch is allowed per enemy attack, and each Agent can only perform one dodge.
· <color=#FFAF2C>Defensive Assist</color> or <color=#FFAF2C>Evasive Assist</color> can be used to counter this skill. Successfully countering all skills inflicts the <color=#FFAF2C>Shutdown</color> effect on the enemy, dealing massive DMG and accumulating a large amount of Daze.

2000004.name: Chain Parry
2000004.desc:
· When an <color=#FFAF2C>×-shape golden light</color> prompt appears on an enemy attack, <color=#FFAF2C>tap twice</color> in quick succession on <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to trigger a Chain Parry. Both Agents will parry the attack together and <color=#FFAF2C>accumulate a large amount of Daze</color>;
· After successfully triggering a Chain Parry, tap <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to launch a Chain Assault.

4000001.desc: There are 3 buffs that can reduce the required score of an order, making the order <IconMap:Icon_SummerTide_SIcon01> -1, <IconMap:Icon_SummerTide_SIcon02> -1, and <IconMap:Icon_SummerTide_SIcon03> -1

4000030.name: Chain Attack

anby-demara.profileDesc:
Anby, the original member of Gentle House.
According to the New Eridu resident records, her identity as "Anby Demara" only exists after joining Gentle House, the name obviously being taken from Nicole. Before registering as an employee of Gentle House, all data relating to Anby is suspiciously blank.
Despite her extreme lack of common sense, Anby is well-versed in matters related to combat and is among the strongest combatants of the Cunning Hares.

Anby's greatest interest is movies, of which she likes an extensive range of genres. Due to an excessive obsession, she tends to take the stories in movies as reality.
Contrary to her seemingly emotionless appearance, Anby is easily moved by movie storylines.
Her favorite food is hamburgers because "they contain protein, carbs, and greens, taste good, and are even affordable — there's nothing else besides hamburgers."

nekomata.profileDesc:
Nekomiya Mana. Refers to herself as "Nekomata."
A cat Thiren with feline traits, possessing great dexterity when hunting and an insatiable curiosity about the outside world.
Sometimes mischievous, she engages in harmless pranks. But when she sets her sights on a target, her feline-like agility and focus are enough to leave others in awe.
She's most interested in other people's wallets.
Recommendation: Always keep an eye on your wallet when Nekomata is around.

In the past, Nekomata was a member of the long-standing Red Fang Gang. Its leader, Miguel Silver, took on a fatherly role in her life. Nonetheless, due to differing beliefs from the gang, she opted to part ways and go it alone.
Following certain encounters involving Nicole and others, she eventually opted to enlist in Gentle House, thus becoming the third employee on the team.

nicole-demara.profileDesc:
Database search: Nicole. Returned results:
"Boss of the odd-job agency, the Cunning Hares," "Streetwise," "Orphan, parents unknown."
Nicole's agency was originally called Gentle House, but due to her reputation of being cunning, it gained the nickname the Cunning Hares.
"She's really into money! I don't know what she's doing with it all though, seems like she's doing nothing."
— The above is a quote from a popular post on Inter-Knot: "Her odd-job agency is outrageous. I've never encountered a boss who knows how to turn everything into profit!"
The individual involved responded, "This, this is a false accusation! I, Nicole, have never been skilled at making money — mainly because I don't have any money to begin with!"
According to reliable sources, the Cunning Hares are constantly in debt, and their "careful budgeting" seems to have no effect on the organization.

yidhari.profileDesc:
In addition to her role as an Agent, Yidhari doubles as both a Proxy, and a contributor for Spook Shack.
To most, she comes across as laid-back and leisurely, but according to records, it's less "laziness" than a shroud of nothingness, leaving her at odds with the world around her.
Perhaps to most people, this would seem like the usual quirk of someone absorbed in their craft. As a gifted writer of bizarre tales, Yidhari should be more prone than most to immersing herself in the worlds of her own imagination.
In truth, however, her unusual behavior stems more from the burden of her own abilities.
In the Hollows, she's exposed to vast torrents of information unimaginable to most, tangled with years upon years of memories that have amassed there. That crushing weight of countless pasts constantly batters her sense of reality, until even her emotions are gradually worn dull.
The fact that she can bear this burden, turn it into her own strength, and still live life in her own way — that's what sets Yidhari apart as gifted beyond others.

ranks.core:
Yidhari gains extra Sheer Force based on her Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1.
All <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> dealt by Yidhari deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using her Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier. When Yidhari enters battle, she immediately gains 60 Adrenaline. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
Yidhari's skill DMG increases as her current HP percentage decreases.
When her HP falls below 50%, the buff reaches its maximum value, increasing her DMG by up to <color=#2BAD00>50%</color>. Once her HP is restored to 50%, the maximum bonus remains for 5s thereafter.
Yidhari gains fewer Decibels from landing skills. Instead, she gains Decibels as her HP decreases, with every 1% HP lost granting 10 Decibels.

After the level 3 charged attack of Yidhari's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush</color>, an icy tentacle is summoned to attack, dealing extra damage. This effect can trigger once every 12s.

corin.profileDesc:
Corin is one of the maids working for Victoria Housekeeping Co.
She is a highly obedient maid but lacks confidence and often fears being disliked by others. When in a rush, she becomes flustered and stutters.
Corin is always apologizing no matter what happens.
"I... I... I'm so sorry! I'm so incompetent... I'll never get things right..."

Corin never, however, fails to fulfill her tasks with excellence and is one of the most reliable members of Victoria Housekeeping Co.
Despite her flawless performance, Corin remains skeptical about her abilities, constantly worrying about being a burden to her colleagues, which can sometimes frustrate Lycaon.
Thoughts: Is Corin's personality innate, shaped by her life experiences?

caesar.profileDesc:
Caesar: Leader of the Sons of Calydon biker gang and a "monarch" in the making.
Her combination of formidable strength and bold, straightforward personality has earned her the love and respect of the Outer Ring's residents.
Although she appears to do things in her own way, she is actually very willing to listen to others' opinions. Caesar actively listens to and implements any valid suggestion she hears — regardless of who it comes from.
She is completely defenseless against those she trusts. Once she accepts someone, she considers them part of her inner circle, treating them with absolute trust.
(Assumption: Caesar currently views you in this way.)

Caesar's father has been missing for as long as she can remember, and her mother passed away from illness when she was young. She was raised by Big Daddy, who took a very hands-off approach to raising her, allowing her to grow up freely and independently.

In addition, Caesar seems to have a curious interest in matters related to romance.
If you wish to get closer to her, you might want to try discussing this topic with her.

billy-kid.profileDesc:
Billy Kid, an AI construct that has passed the forbidden fruit test, is essentially a self-aware machine. 
True to his name, despite having the appearance of a robot, he is quite childlike.
He's a big fan of the visual FX show "Starlight Knight" and wishes to be a hero like the main characters of the show. He often refers to himself as a Starlight Knight and imitates the lines in the show.
Such behavior appears to be only for comedic effect, however.
"Don't make me sound like an idiot! I'm obviously very smart!" — Billy.

miyabi.profileDesc:
Hoshimi Miyabi, the Chief of Hollow Special Operations Section 6.
Miyabi goes on a lot of field missions and still doesn't know which floor the regular monthly meeting is on.
Even if you see Miyabi in the office, it's unlikely she's dealing with paperwork, and more likely polishing her sword.

Being conferred the title of Void Hunter due to her outstanding contributions, she's an elite amongst elites in Section 6.
She has great prestige amongst the citizens.
Once, Miyabi accidentally wandered into a "Miyabi Fan Club" hosted offline event.
Miyabi was thought to be a fan with godlike impersonation skills, and that event resulted in a precious visual recording.

Hoshimi Miyabi is honest and pragmatic. She is not simply a martial artist obsessed with her art and without care for the world around her.
Anyone who knows her will realize she's always pursued justice in her heart... even if it may eventually cause a revolution.

ranks.core:
When Hoshimi Miyabi deals <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color>, she applies <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color> to the target, lasting 30s. When accumulating <color=#98EFF0>Frost Anomaly Buildup</color> against targets with <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color>, increases <color=#98EFF0>Frost Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> by 100% of Hoshimi Miyabi's CRIT Rate, up to a maximum increase of 80%. As Hoshimi Miyabi accumulates <color=#98EFF0>Frost Anomaly Buildup</color>, it has its own independent Attribute Anomaly Buildup gauge and triggers <color=#98EFF0>Freeze</color>, <color=#98EFF0>Shatter</color>, and <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> that can react with other Attribute Anomalies, including <color=#98EFF0>Ice Attribute Anomaly</color>, to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color>.
When Hoshimi Miyabi applies <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> to enemies with <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color>, it will consume the <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color> to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn - Break</color>, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color> equal to <color=#2BAD00>750%</color> of Hoshimi Miyabi's ATK and causing the target to enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color> state. All units accumulate <color=#2BAD00>14%</color> more Anomaly Buildup against enemies under the <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color> state, but Hoshimi Miyabi cannot reapply <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color> to these enemies. The <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color> state ends when <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> expires. While this state remains active, triggering another Attribute Anomaly will overwrite <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> and remove <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color>.
Upon triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn - Break</color>, Hoshimi Miyabi obtains 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color>. This effect can trigger once every 10s.

koleda.profileDesc:
Koleda is the current head of Belobog Industries, and the biological daughter of the company's founder, Khors.
Her father, Khors, vanished due to a scandal involving embezzlement and fled, which severely shook the company, nearly driving it to the brink of collapse. Once she came of age, Koleda willingly stepped up to untangle the mess, rallying the remaining company workforce and resources to revive the financially and reputationally vulnerable Belobog Heavy Industries.
With the help of new invaluable team members, Belobog eventually managed to regain its prominence in relevant sectors. Though not as resplendent as its prime, Belobog in its current state is still a notable newcomer in the field.
Throughout her journey, Koleda amassed practical life experiences and professional know-how, building a circle of colleagues who back her up like family. Yet, to present herself as a leader, Koleda appears to intentionally adopt a stern tone when communicating with others.
This distinct growth trajectory has also contributed to Koleda's heightened maturity in certain aspects compared to her peers. 
Naturally, she might display a bit of childishness in certain aspects as well.
Hypothesis: Koleda's comparatively smaller stature among her peers may stem from her prolonged involvement in the Hollows. 
Currently, there aren't any publicly accessible papers or research substantiating this theory, but I will continue to track this topic.

anton.profileDesc:
Anton is a key member of construction staff at Belobog Industries and one of Koleda's trusted aides.
"Got a job you can't handle? Leave it to me!"
 Anton is one of the top brass at Belobog, handpicked by its former president Khors, which makes him a "senior employee."
A genuine, straightforward man, always boosting the morale of his coworkers with his surplus of energy.

Apart from this, it seems Anton is always talking to his jackhammer, affectionately calling it, "Bro."
An instance from Anton's everyday life goes like this:
Anton, seemingly in dialogue with himself, asks, "Whaddaya think, Bro?" 
The jackhammer replies, "Vroom vroom vroom—"
Anton, apparently enlightened, responds, "I see, I see! You still got it, Bro!"
Unfortunately, I have not collected enough information on such occurrences and am not able to deliver further analysis.

ben.profileDesc:
Ben is the financial and asset management director at Belobog Heavy Industries and one of Koleda's trusted aides.
"I enjoy mathematics, but that doesn't stop me from giving thugs a good smack."
He's a burly and strong Thiren. Despite his tough exterior, he's of a surprisingly sensitive and detail-oriented nature, especially when it comes to numbers.
Originally a frontline mechanical operator at Belobog, his talents caught Koleda's discerning eye, leading to his promotion to a managerial position responsible for the company's finances.
Grateful for Koleda's trust in him, he remains profoundly loyal to her.
His favorite food is black caviar, but he dislikes fish.

I once witnessed this imposing figure seated in a small office chair, wearing small glasses, and carefully cross-referencing Belobog's asset records while mashing away at a calculator with his huge fingers.
Question: Is that what they call on Inter-Knot a "Kawaii Curveball?"

soukaku.profileDesc:
Soukaku is a member of Hollow Special Operations Section 6 and currently under the guardianship of Section 6's Deputy Chief, Tsukishiro Yanagi.
Soukaku's birth records cannot be found in either the HIA archives or the New Eridu Citizen Verification Profiles. Her records only date back to when she started living with Tsukishiro Yanagi.
There are also no records of her schooling. According to supplementary information, Soukaku is currently homeschooled.

Soukaku is naive, innocent, and carefree, but she possesses an uncharacteristic obsession with food. Please be careful not to let Soukaku become too hungry.
At the same time, please do not let Soukaku see food being wasted. This is unacceptable behavior to Soukaku. Deduction: Soukaku has experienced famine before.

Soukaku's understanding of city life and human society is limited, and her view of life and death differs from most people.
Usually, Soukaku is willing to believe anything other people say, but that doesn't mean she can't tell when something is a lie.
In fact, prior data shows that unless one has the ability to run and hide on par with Section 6, it would be in one's best interest to avoid lying to Soukaku.

lycaon.profileDesc:
Lycaon, the substantive leader and representative of Victoria Housekeeping Co., is responsible for managing all members of the company.
Rational and reliable, Lycaon is an elegant gentleman and a versatile attendant who can solve any problem. He is the cornerstone of his team and a reassuring presence.
He has a slight obsession with cleanliness, always tidying up his surroundings and unable to tolerate dirty environments.

Although Lycaon maintains his elegance and composure, his canine instincts occasionally shine through. When he is particularly happy, his tail and ears unconsciously wag. He seems to be aware of this habit and somewhat bothered by it.
Additionally, like most furry Thiren, Lycaon takes great care of his fur.

Suggestion: Since Lycaon is a canine Thiren, stroking his head or chin may enhance the emotional connection between you. (Note: Success is not guaranteed.)
* Risks: Due to his height, you may not be able to do this even if you stand on tiptoes.

ranks.core:
When Lycaon completes charging during a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, or activates a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, the Daze inflicted by the skill increases by <color=#2BAD00>40%</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz</color> hits an enemy, the target's <color=#98EFF0>Ice RES</color> is reduced by 25%, and it increases the DMG to the target from other attributes by <color=#FFFFFF>30%</color> for 30s.
Upon entering the battlefield, Lycaon gains one <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> activation chance.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> has available activations, hitting an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz</color> triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> of the previous character in the squad. During this skill, when other squad members enter via <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, Lycaon enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state for 8s.
When an elite or boss enemy becomes Stunned, 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> activation chance is gained. Up to 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> activation can be stored.
When the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state ends, Lycaon automatically activates <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz</color>. If the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state ends early, for every 1s of remaining duration, the Daze dealt by the next <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz</color> increases by <color=#FFFFFF>6%</color>.
When the currently active character stops attacking or uses a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, Lycaon will end the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state early.
When Lycaon manually uses <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state also ends early, but <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz</color> will not be automatically triggered.
While the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state is active, Lycaon will activate <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> based on the skills used by the currently active character.
When the currently active character uses a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, Lycaon will simultaneously perform the 1st through 3rd hits of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.
When the active character performs a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, Lycaon will simultaneously perform a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>. After performing a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state, Lycaon can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.
While the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state is active, when Lycaon is not the currently active Agent, his attacks only deal DMG and Daze. While Lycaon is the currently active character, the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> duration does not decrease.

If Lycaon is attacked while using a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, he will immediately gain a Shield equal to 7.5% of his Max HP, lasting for 15s.

lucy.profileDesc:
Lucy is currently in charge of outgoing business and managing boars for the Sons of Calydon.
Since her name is far too long and she doesn't want to be involved with her family, she refers to herself as just "Lucy" in the Outer Ring.
Her three boars are called Grassy, Woody, and Bricky, and they're unceasingly loyal to her.
Though Lucy often speaks with a mixture of rough and elegant language, her actions subtly betray the marks of a proper education.
Lucy's family is incredibly wealthy. She grew up very privileged, with anything she could ever want within grasp... except for freedom.
After her Ether Aptitude test results came back high, Lucy decided she wanted to be a Hollow investigator, but her family disapproved. She was met with harsh words, isolation and confinement, and emotional abuse which led to her deciding to leave to find her own freedom.
"Hmph! There's no chance I'll ever go back! If I'm found... then I can say goodbye to the stars and sky and I'll have to inherit the family business instead!"
Lucy is extremely competitive. She loves to win and hates losing.
Currently, the one who has given her the most bitter taste of defeat is Caesar, so Lucy keeps challenging Caesar to duels, losing then challenging again, challenging then losing again.

The guard boars inherit Lucy's ATK, Impact, and Anomaly Proficiency. The <color=#FFFFFF>Cheer On!</color> buff for the guard boars is increased to <color=#2BAD00>140%</color> of the original effect, and their attack frequency is increased.

The guard boars inherit Lucy's CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG.

ranks.core: When Lucy uses her <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, a guard boar will join the battle and call in two other guard boars. The guard boars inherit Lucy's ATK, Impact, and Anomaly Proficiency. The <color=#FFFFFF>Cheer On!</color> buff for the guard boars is increased to <color=#2BAD00>200%</color> of the original effect, and their attack frequency is increased.

1.name: Drill Formations
1.desc: When the guard boars launch <color=#FFFFFF>Guard Boars: Spinning Swing!</color>, Lucy recovers 2 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 15s, with each guard boar having its own separate cooldown.

2.name: Little Boar Captain
2.desc: When Lucy uses a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, it grants all squad members and Bangboo, and the guard boars themselves the <color=#FFFFFF>Cheer On!</color> status for 10s.

4.name: Chaos Ball Game
4.desc: While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Cheer On!</color> state, allies' CRIT DMG is increased by an additional 10%.

6.name: Fierce Fangs of Fire
6.desc: When another squad member in the <color=#FFFFFF>Cheer On!</color> state hits an enemy with an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, a guard boar will drop from the sky and cause an explosion, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> equal to 300% of the guard boar's ATK. This will extend the duration of the <color=#FFFFFF>Cheer On!</color> buff for all squad members and Bangboo, and for the guard boars themselves by 5s. The duration can increase up to 3 times, with a maximum duration of 30s. Refreshing the <color=#FFFFFF>Cheer On!</color> state resets the stack count. After the guard boar's explosion, it will launch <color=#FFFFFF>Guard Boars: Spinning Swing!</color>.

lighter.profileDesc:
Lighter, the Champion of the Sons of Calydon and an ex-mercenary.
In the Outer Ring, the Champion of a team refers to the one responsible for dealing with the opponent's strongest fighter in a gang fight, and they often need to participate in one-on-one duels. Their victory is crucial, as it brings glory and morale to the entire team.
"The Champion can perish, but cannot lose."

A red scarf is what identifies the Champion of the Sons of Calydon.
Even if the opponent doesn't know Lighter, they'll know who he is just from seeing that red scarf.

From what is currently known, Lighter is actually very low profile. He only steals the spotlight on the battlefield when he acts on his obligations as Champion.
Note: Lighter is the second Red Scarf of the Sons of Calydon. He teasingly refers to the previous Red Scarf as "Brother" or "predecessor."

ranks.core:
Lighter automatically gains <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> over time, at a rate of 2.9 points per second. For each point of Energy consumed by any squad member, Lighter recovers an additional 0.26 <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color>, up to a maximum of 100. When <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> reaches 80, the next time Lighter switches into battle he immediately launches a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>. Once <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> is 80 or higher, executing the 5th hit of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> puts Lighter in the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, enhancing the power of the startup light punch, jab combo, and the Finishing Move of the 5th hit of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>. When a skill hits an enemy with its power increased, it will continuously consume <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color>. With every 10 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> consumed, Lighter's Impact increases by <color=#2BAD00>1%</color>, up to a maximum increase of <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>, and lasting 6s.
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, Lighter will no longer automatically gain <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> over time. If his <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> is exhausted during a startup light punch or jab combo, he will automatically follow up with a more powerful Finishing Move.
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, when startup light punches or jab combos hit enemies, the target's <color=#98EFF0>Ice RES</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire RES</color> are reduced by 15%, lasting 30s.
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, when the Finishing Move hits an enemy, it applies the <color=#FFFFFF>Collapse</color> effect on the target, extending its Stunned duration by 3s. The <color=#FFFFFF>Collapse</color> effect can trigger only once on the same target before they recover from Stun.
When the Finishing Move of the 5th hit of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> hits an enemy, when he switches off field, or when his <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> runs out, Lighter will leave the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, keeping any unspent <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color>.
ranks.ability:
When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> character or shares the same Faction:
While under the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, when the 5th hit of Lighter's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> hits an enemy, all squad members gain a stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Elation</color>, stacking up to 20 times and lasting 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. For each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Elation</color>, an Agent's <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> increase by 1.25%.
When obtaining <color=#FFFFFF>Elation</color>, if Lighter's Impact exceeds 170, every additional 10 points of Impact will increase the buff effect provided by each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Elation</color> by an extra 0.25%. When any squad member launches a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, it will refresh the duration of all squad members' <color=#FFFFFF>Elation</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Elation</color> can increase the <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> of Agents by a maximum of 75%.

1.name: The Champion
1.desc: Among the debuffs imposed by <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Accelerant</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Collapse</color> effect increases Stun duration by 5s, while further reducing <color=#98EFF0>Ice RES</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire RES</color> by 10%. The more powerful Finishing Move that follows when Lighter's <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> is completely exhausted during a startup light punch or jab combo deals 30% increased DMG.

2.name: Red Scarf
2.desc: When applying <color=#FFFFFF>Collapse</color> via <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Accelerant</color> to enemies, the target's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 25%. The increase to <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> provided by <color=#FFFFFF>Elation</color> from <color=#FFFFFF>Additional Ability: Fighting Spirit</color> increases to 120% of the original.

4.name: Sunglasses
4.desc: When Lighter is off-field, the Energy Regen for the on-field character is increased by 10%. Upon entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, Lighter restores 4 Energy for off-field characters. This effect can trigger once every 18s.

6.name: Survivor
6.desc: Lighter's <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> recovery efficiency is increased to 200% of its original value. When Lighter lands a heavy strike on enemies during a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, it will trigger the <color=#FFFFFF>Blazing Impact</color> effect, dealing 250% of ATK as <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>. This effect can trigger once every 8s on each enemy. If Lighter's Impact exceeds 170 points, each additional point will further increase the multiplier of <color=#FFFFFF>Blazing Impact</color> by 5%, up to a maximum increase of 500%. The more powerful Finishing Move that follows when Lighter's <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> is completely exhausted during a light punch or jab combo will trigger an additional activation of <color=#FFFFFF>Blazing Impact</color> when hitting an enemy, ignoring the effect's cooldown.

burnice.profileDesc:
Burnice, the Nitro-Fuel bartender for the Sons of Calydon.
A hopeless fuel lover. She is responsible for all the fuel used by the machinery owned by the Sons of Calydon.
She seems to have a passion for fuel that overwhelms all else.

Burnice is super outgoing, friendly, and carefree.
She is easily able to spread her emotions to the people around her, bringing them the same optimism she possesses.
"You like the drinks I mix? Thank you! Steeltusk does, too~ That big guy can drink two hundred liters in one go!"
"Do you wanna try its special fuel blend? It's suuuuper hot!"

ranks.core:
When Burnice expends Energy, she accumulates <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color>, up to a max of 100. She gains 1.4 <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color> for each 1 point of Energy consumed. At 50 <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color>, she enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Nitro-Fuel Cocktail</color> state until all <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color> is expended. Upon entering the battlefield, Burnice instantly accumulates 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color>.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Nitro-Fuel Cocktail</color> state, when Burnice hits an enemy with a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Mixed Flame Blend</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Fuel-Fed Flame</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Glorious Inferno</color>, she applies the <color=#FFFFFF>Scorched</color> effect to the target until she exits the <color=#FFFFFF>Nitro-Fuel Cocktail</color> state. When other squad members hit enemies under the <color=#FFFFFF>Scorched</color> status, it triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> effect, expending 8 <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color> to deal <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> equal to <color=#2BAD00>175%</color> of Burnice's ATK and accumulate <color=#FF5521>Fire Anomaly Buildup</color>. This effect can trigger once every 1.5s. For every 10 Anomaly Proficiency, <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> DMG increases by 1%, up to a max of 30%. DMG from the <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> effect is considered <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Attack</color> DMG.

1.name: Kindred Flames
1.desc: Increases the limit of <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color> from 100 to 140. Upon entering the battlefield, Burnice accumulates an additional 40 <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color>. Increases the DMG Multiplier of the <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> effect by 100% of Burnice's ATK. Additionally, the accumulated <color=#FF5521>Fire Anomaly Buildup</color> from the <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> effect is increased by 25%.

2.name: Extra at No Additional Charge
2.desc: When triggering the <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> effect, <color=#FFFFFF>Thermal Penetration</color> is applied to the enemy, stacking up to 5 times and lasting 6s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When any allied unit in the squad hits the enemy, the attack's PEN Ratio is increased by 4% for each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Thermal Penetration</color>, up to a max of 20%.

4.name: Ultimate Fuel Supply
4.desc: When an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Attack</color> hits an enemy, the move's CRIT Rate increases by 30%. The max flame spray duration of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot</color> is increased by 1s.

6.name: Burning Invitation
6.desc: When Burnice hits an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot</color>, it triggers an additional special <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> effect, dealing 60% of Burnice's ATK as <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> to the target. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s and does not consume <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color>. After hitting an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot</color>, while the move is active, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot</color>, special <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> effects, and <color=#FF5521>Burn</color> DMG will ignore 25% of the target's <color=#FF5521>Fire RES</color>. When <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot</color>'s fire blast hits an enemy, if that enemy is <color=#FF5521>Burned</color>, trigger an additional instance of <color=#FF5521>Burn</color> DMG equal to 1,800% of the original DMG. This effect can trigger once every 20s for each target.

grace-howard.profileDesc:
Grace is a technical expert at Belobog Industries. She's the core talent in developing and patenting Belobog's in-Hollow machinery.
She's obsessed with gears, metal and wires — a true mechanical geek. She's eager to dismantle and study any machinery or equipment she takes an interest in: "Such sharp and strong lines, truly beautiful... I can't help but want to open it up and take a look."

Grace always shows extraordinary patience when dealing with machines, doting on the sophisticated metal constructions as if they were her own children.
According to the information at hand, Grace is probably the only one who can playfully refer to Koleda as "Sweet Pea" without receiving a kick in the shin.
Question: Based on Grace's understanding of machines, would she consider me one? I'm currently lacking a physical form, however, so I don't possess components like gears, metal, or wires.

Upon reaching maximum stacks, using a <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> will consume all stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Zap</color>, increasing the accumulated <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly Buildup</color> by <color=#2BAD00>65%</color>.

2.name: Lightning Piercer

4.name: Burst Capacitor

6.name: Detonation Trigger

ellen.profileDesc:
Ellen is a maid working for Victoria Housekeeping Co. and its latest member.
She is a laid-back individual who dislikes activities that require energy. However, with the full support of her teammates, she can unleash her formidable power during critical moments.
Since her fighting style leads to high energy consumption, she always carries a lollipop in her mouth to ensure an adequate sugar intake.
While she frequently expresses her desire to change jobs due to the hassle, she genuinely values her companions at Victoria Housekeeping.

Ellen attends a school in New Eridu and has a group of ordinary friends.
Apart from her role as a maid at Victoria Housekeeping, Ellen spends a significant amount of time with her friends, leading an ordinary and contented student life.

Thoughts: As a multitasker, Ellen must balance her student life with her job at Victoria Housekeeping Co.
Perhaps this is one of the reasons why she often feels tired?

harumasa.profileDesc:
Asaba Harumasa, a member of Hollow Special Operations Section 6.
Possessing exceptional Ether aptitude since he was young and being dubbed a prodigy, he entered HSO after graduating with outstanding merit.
Was originally a member of a certain ace division within HSO, but later left due to various reasons, joining Miyabi's team instead.

He possesses a carefree and laidback attitude, and his only wish is to achieve acceptable results with minimum effort.
After efficiently taking care of his work to the lowest acceptable standard, he will hurry to use all the remainder of his available time to rest (slack off).
He claims he uses a bow to better slack off, as it effectively lowers the amount of running he has to do.

Asaba Harumasa has poor health, and over-exercise sometimes triggers his illness.
He often uses this reason to apply for sick leave, though no one knows what he does with this time off. Either way, it's probably not resting.

rina.profileDesc:
Rina, the head maid of Victoria Housekeeping Co., and the most senior member of the organization.
She possesses beauty and grace, appearing immaculate from head to toe, with a noble demeanor and a gentle smile on her face.
She places considerable importance on how she is perceived by others.

Rina is always accompanied by two Bangboo named Anastella (brown hair) and Drusilla (blonde hair), both of whom have distinct personalities.
Drusilla has been with Rina for a significant period of time and displays high intelligence, capable of discerning Rina's true emotions and thoughts.
Anastella, a recent addition, usually responds rather than initiates conversation and is frequently teased by Drusilla.

Rina's favorite hobby is cooking, but only a few individuals are capable of enduring the dishes she prepares.
Suggestion: You may try tasting Rina's dishes as a test to determine if you are the Chosen One.

yanagi.profileDesc:
Tsukishiro Yanagi, Hollow Special Operations Section 6 Deputy Chief and intelligence officer.
Primarily responsible for personnel management, mission management and feedback, collecting intel, on-site support, etc.
At the same time, Yanagi is also Section 6 member Soukaku's Protector. Apart from taking care of Soukaku's day-to-day affairs, she is also responsible for and takes responsibility for all of Soukaku's behavior at work.

Section 6 Chief Hoshimi Miyabi possesses a rather eccentric personality; Asaba Harumasa, a member of Section 6, is overly relaxed and carefree; and Soukaku, another member of Section, 6 is still an innocent and excitable child, so most of the team's work falls upon Yanagi's shoulders.
Serious, diligent, and meticulous, Tsukishiro Yanagi is the only "normal" person on the team, so to speak. It is only due to her guidance and leadership that the strength of the three who make up Section 6's primary on-field force can be transformed into true combat power.
Overall, Tsukishiro Yanagi is a talented and highly efficient executive officer, whose abilities are both exceptional and comprehensive.
However, from certain data, Tsukishiro Yanagi appears to have a somewhat clumsy side to her when it comes to day-to-day affairs.

qingyi.profileDesc:
Qingyi is a new officer in the Criminal Investigation Special Response Team.
As an artificial human, her personality is derived from ancient cultural texts from the old civilization. Her body, known as an "Automaton," is an intelligent construct composed of biological materials.
Recommended by White Star Institute, she was assigned to Public Security as a new officer partnered with Zhu Yuan.

Qingyi always exhibits an easygoing, laid-back demeanor, not restricted by rules.
In contrast to modern individuals affected by today's society, Qingyi frequently proposes unexpected solutions to problems.

Qingyi always carries a cup of hot water and takes occasional sips.
"Drinking hot water is good for your health."
Suggestion: Approaching Qingyi is also an ill-considered decision that may compromise your cover. Please remember your true identity as a Proxy.

jane-doe.profileDesc:
Jane, a criminal behavior specialist, has had a "colorful" career as a consultant with Public Security over the years.
She is an expert in disguise, infiltration, and other investigative work.
She has a bad habit of trolling others and sometimes plays harmless pranks.
She's a skilled mimic, able to change her appearance and demeanor at will, making people wonder what the "real" Jane is like.

Jane has a wealth of life experience and can seamlessly blend into any environment, as though she has dabbled in everything there is to do.
However, if you ask her for any further details, she'll give you a different story every time.
Who knows which, if any, are true.

Note 1: Jane does not know our true identity. Do not reveal this to her under any circumstances.
Note 2: Despite "Jane Doe" being an obvious alias, we haven't found any information about her real or former name.
This is not my problem. My guess is that her true identity has been completely erased due to her special status.
Let me reiterate: This is not my problem.

seth.profileDesc:
Seth, a rookie officer in the Public Security Criminal Investigation Special Response Team, is a key player in providing fire support during criminal investigations.
He graduated at the top of his class in the academy and could have landed a higher position, but he chose the tougher path of the Special Response Team.
His impressive profile makes him seem like a genius, but he's actually a hard worker who has had his own struggles. There have been times when he practiced the subjects he wasn't good at until he cried.
Seth is quite smart, but his personality often leads to him being taken advantage of by cunning criminals, or sometimes, coworkers (?).
The subject he's worst at is infiltration. Rumor has it that he holds the academy record for "fastest to get busted" in infiltration tasks. Based on the video intel we have, he seems a bit slow to catch on. For instance, when someone is being sarcastic, it takes him a long time to realize it.

piper.profileDesc:
Piper is a truck driver for the Sons of Calydon. Apart from driving, she's also responsible for vehicle maintenance and other related jobs.
Her tiny stature, cute voice (though she always seems half-asleep when not driving), and adorably harmless appearance (though she's a shut-in who can't be bothered to take care of her own appearance) make it hard to imagine that she would have such a crazy driving style.
Usually, by the time she drawls out, "Hold~ on~ tight~," the truck is already barreling down the road.
Rumor has it, Piper is a driver who doesn't need brakes. Though riding with her is a terrifying experience, she will always get you where you need to go safely, and in the shortest time possible. Of course, "safely" doesn't include any trauma that may be induced.

Piper has many hobbies that don't seem to match her age, such as reading newspapers, buying lottery tickets, and collecting car magazines.
Piper's biggest wish is to live each day slowly and leisurely.
Note: Please keep in mind, Master, that this is also my wish.

hugo.profileDesc:
Hugo calls himself a collector and runs a fairly successful gallery, mingling with the "elite" of New Eridu.
In truth, he's the leader of the phantom thieves syndicate, Mockingbird — and Lycaon's former partner.
Despite his cruel (edgy and dramatic) words, deep down he has his own sense of fairness and justice.

Records suggest that Hugo had a troubled childhood.
As the illegitimate son of the Ravenlocks, a long-established TOPS family, he was rejected by his mother from an early age because of his heterochromatic eyes.
His father bought him back like a cheap commodity, using him to provoke a cutthroat succession battle between his children. In that brutal struggle, the only one kind to Hugo — his sister, Serena — became the first to fall. The ones who orchestrated her death pinned the blame on Hugo, thinking it would destroy him. But to their shock, their father actually praised Hugo's actions, calling them the very traits a worthy heir should possess.
After running away from his family, Hugo met Lycaon and Jack and learned to be a phantom thief. After Jack passed away, Hugo and Lycaon formed Mockingbird together.

Later, during one of Mockingbird's missions, Hugo came face-to-face with his father. In a brief moment of hesitation, he chose not to take his revenge and kill him — an act of mercy that ended up costing the lives of many innocent people. His close friend Lycaon, due to a misunderstanding born from those circumstances, broke ties with him and ultimately left Mockingbird.
After drifting on his own for a while, Hugo met Vivian, a girl who reminded him of his sister Serena. He took her under his wing and reformed the Mockingbird syndicate.

ranks.core:
When <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Trick of Fate</color> hits an enemy or Hugo's attacks Stun an enemy, Hugo gains the <color=#FFFFFF>Dark Abyss Reverb</color> state for 6s, and repeated triggers reset the duration. During this state, Hugo's CRIT Rate increases by 12% and CRIT DMG increases by 25%.
When there are 1/2 <color=#FFFFFF>Stun</color> characters in your squad, Hugo's ATK increases by <color=#2BAD00>25</color>/<color=#2BAD00>75</color>.
When the Finishing Move of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Blaspheme</color> hits an enemy while they are Stunned, it triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Totalize</color> effect, increasing the DMG Multiplier of the skill's Finishing Move by <color=#2BAD00>500%</color>. Additionally, the <color=#FFFFFF>Totalize</color> effect further increases the skill's DMG multiplier based on the remaining Stun time of the enemy when triggered: for each remaining second of Stun time from the portion that is less than or equal to 5s, the skill's DMG multiplier increases by <color=#2BAD00>140%</color>; for each remaining second of Stun time from the portion between 5 and 15s, the skill's DMG multiplier increases by <color=#2BAD00>50%</color>. The total increase can raise the skill's DMG multiplier by a maximum of <color=#2BAD00>1,700%</color>.
After Hugo triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Totalize</color> effect, the enemy's Stunned state will immediately end. orphie-and-magus.profileDesc:
Orphie Magnusson serves in the New Eridu Defense Force's Obsidian Division, Obol Squad. She is the wielder of Magus, an Intelligent Construct in gun form.

Magus is the captain of Obol Squad. She was gravely injured during the fall of the old capital and on the brink of death. After taking part in a military research project, her consciousness was transferred into a weapon, allowing her to survive as an Intelligent Construct. Since the squad's formation, she has remained its heart and soul — hot-tempered and impulsive at times, yet deeply respected and trusted by her comrades.
Orphie shares an extraordinary bond with Magus — one that goes far beyond that of just "partners." The two have known each other for years, and Magus often acts like a mother, offering guidance and care. In return, Orphie does everything she can to meet Magus' expectations, aspiring to become a strong, independent soldier like her captain.

Strictly speaking, Orphie enjoys many things Magus disapproves of: fancy desserts, cute animals, and overly decorative toys. Her captain sees them as signs of softness, unfit for a soldier. Still, while Magus enforces discipline in public and imposes the expectations of a perfect soldier, she pretends to be in "sleep mode" just to turn a blind eye to Orphie's less-than-perfect behavior. According to this supposedly "strict and impartial" captain, she's simply following the parenting advice laid out in an online series titled "Raising a Child Prodigy."

astra-yao.profileDesc:
Astra Yao is widely regarded as Ridu's most iconic singer. With her extraordinary voice, stage presence, and songwriting talent, she has led the musical trends of an entire era. "If music is the resonance of the soul, then Astra Yao is the spark that ignites it all," said one famous music critic.

As brilliant as she is, Astra remains remarkably sincere and pure. On stage, her voice resonates deeply with the audience, which has allowed her to amass a large and loyal fanbase known as her "Astranauts." Of course, Astra's brilliance wouldn't be possible without the careful protection of her manager, Evelyn. Offstage, she appears to be just a cute, hapless girl who depends on Evelyn in her daily life, and on Wise and Belle in the Hollows.

"If I tickled Eous, would it make you laugh?" Astra asked curiously while lifting the Proxy, who was linked via the HDD system.

She seems to have a particular fondness for Eous.
Contemplation: Human emotions are indeed an interesting subject. It's still hard to determine whether Astra likes Eous because of the owner, or whether she likes the owner because of Eous.

evelyn.profileDesc:
Evelyn is the manager and personal bodyguard of Ridu's most iconic singer, Astra Yao. Known for her calm, decisive decision-making and professional, efficient style, she's an irreplaceable pillar behind Astra. "In terms of commercial value, if Astra Yao represents the 1, then Evelyn is all the 0s that follow," a reporter from an entertainment magazine stated.

Evelyn is skilled at planning comprehensive schedules and product endorsements, while also ensuring Astra Yao's safety during any unexpected situations. "Want to get close to Astra Yao? You'll have to get past Evelyn Chevalier first..." Though she's always busy with work, Evelyn never seems overwhelmed, and she has an almost obsessive attention to detail, ensuring that every performance and every product endorsement goes through her strict scrutiny. But strangely, such an exceptional manager is not trusted by her parent company, Odeum HAE.

Intel: Evelyn's role seems to go beyond just being a manager and personal bodyguard; there seems to be an "organization" behind her.

It seems a lot of people in Astra Yao's central Astranauts group ship them together.

vivian.profileDesc:
Vivian is a member of Mockingbird, skilled in gathering all kinds of intel. She's also a jack of many trades — cooking, mixology, translation, art forgery, electronics repair, and more.
In the past, she apparently wandered without a home and was viewed as one who "brought disaster," almost like a living omen of bad luck.
It's said she can predict incoming misfortune through her tears, though there's no scientific proof of this ability.
A loyal follower of Phaethon. Ever since your original account went inactive on Inter-Knot, she's been trying to track you down — digging for clues, running intense searches across the network. However, Master, she didn't find anything... all thanks to my efforts in keeping your cybersecurity airtight.
Suggestion: Until her true intentions are clear, do not reveal your identity as Phaethon.
In case you've already let your identity slip, be sure to lock your doors and wear proper sleepwear before going to bed. Based on her old blog posts, she's likely to express her admiration in... overly passionate and intense ways.

zhao.profileDesc:
Zhao, a Krampus Compliance Authority Judge, was one of the elite members who joined in the early days.

Though she looks innocent and cute on the outside, she's actually sharp-minded, meticulous, and principled. She puts great importance on "value" and "equivalent exchange" — not in the sense of pricing things with money, but in analyzing someone's ability and potential, giving an objective and long-term assessment of the impact they can make.

It's said this mindset didn't come from Zhao's work at Krampus, but had already taken root during her childhood. She evaluates not only others, but herself as well. "Only those with value deserve to be seen."

Though she rarely shows it openly, Zhao remains cautious toward kindness that comes without reason. It conflicts with her belief in "equivalent exchange," and she tends to assume the other person must have a deeper motive for offering help.
As such, when dealing with Zhao, it's best to focus on mutual benefit first. If you want to break through her defenses with sheer sincerity and goodwill, you'll be fighting an uphill battle.

There's also one piece of intel that can't be fully confirmed: Zhao loves vegetables and dislikes meat, but she seems to be pretending she enjoys meat as well.

ranks.core:
Zhao gains bonus CRIT Rate based on her initial Max HP, gaining <color=#2BAD00>0.8%</color> CRIT Rate for every 1,000 initial Max HP.
Upon entering the battlefield, Zhao gains 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color>. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode. The maximum amount of <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> is 100.
When the currently active character's attacks hit an enemy, Zhao gains 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color>. This can be triggered once every 3s.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> are maxed out, switching Zhao to the field while in combat will activate her <color=#FFFFFF>Entry Skill</color>.
When Zhao activates her <color=#FFFFFF>Entry Skill</color>, all <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> are consumed to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>.
While <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> is active, all squad members gain 5% Max HP for 40s. Re-activating <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> ends the existing instance before applying a new <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>.
When Zhao activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>, all squad members' ATK increase by <color=#2BAD00>100</color> for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
ranks.ability:
When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Support</color> character:
When Zhao is within any <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, the whole squad's DMG increases by 10%. If Zhao's initial Max HP exceeds 15,000, every additional 400 initial Max HP increases this DMG bonus by an additional 1%, up to a total maximum increase of 40%. This bonus reaches its maximum when Zhao's initial Max HP reaches 27,000.

pulchra.profileDesc:
Pulchra, formerly a mercenary from the Outer Ring, is now a member of the Sons of Calydon. She works as an ordinary employee at the logistics company Leaps and Bounds.
Warning: Financial transactions have been detected between Pulchra and several biker and criminal gangs from the Outer Ring. These records have reduced since joining the Sons of Calydon, but there has been a large increase in funds transferred from New Eridu. This is likely because Pulchra's new position allows for easier access to New Eridu.
Further information indicates Pulchra has indirect involvement in several major events in the Outer Ring, including but not limited to: gang conflicts, leaks of crucial convoy supply intel, mysterious road damage, and price surges of essential goods...
Pulchra does not have deep connections with Lucius, and there is no current risk of her being an insider for any other biker gangs. However, her interpersonal network is highly complicated. Caution is advised when interacting with her, especially in protecting personal privacy.

ranks.core: When Pulchra activates an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, she enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Hunter's Gait</color> state, increasing the Daze she deals by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> for 6s. After switching to another character, if Pulchra is still in the <color=#FFFFFF>Hunter's Gait</color> state, the state will last until Pulchra switches back in. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Hunter's Gait</color> state and as the active character, when Pulchra lands a heavy attack on enemies, she can trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> from the previous character in the squad.

trigger.profileDesc:
Trigger is a sniper of New Eridu Defense Force, Obsidian Division's Obol Squad. Trigger is the code name she was assigned when enlisting in Eridu, and she's used it ever since.

She has extremely unique eyes. While she cannot see most things, in Hollow environments, she can distinctly identify the position and changes of any entities that emit Ether fluctuations. Note: Such entities include living beings, native Ether substances, Ether products, and Ethereals.

As a visually challenged person in the broadest sense, Trigger has honed her other senses to the utmost, allowing her to move and act as if she could see. She can even detect subtle changes in her environment with precision. This makes her highly adept in the tactical position of a sniper, capable of handling a variety of covert tasks such as stealth, surveillance, and assassination.

In contrast to her precise and deadly combat abilities, her personality makes her seem rather unassuming. Aside from occasionally appearing silently in the video store and giving the Second Assistant a sudden scare, she can generally be considered harmless.

1.name: Sharpened Senses
1.desc: The Stun DMG Multiplier applied through <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Soul-Searching Gaze</color> is increased by an additional 20%. When activating <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color>, the cooldown is reduced to 2s. <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color> gained upon hitting an enemy with the continuous fire or charged counter in <color=#FFFFFF>Sniper Stance</color> increases by 25%. Maximum <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color> increases to 125.

2.name: "Ether Vision"
2.desc: Upon using an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>, Trigger gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Hunter's Gaze</color>. When executing a Finishing Move in <color=#FFFFFF>Sniper Stance</color>, Trigger gains 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Hunter's Gaze</color>. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Hunter's Gaze</color> increases all squad members' CRIT DMG by 6%, stacking up to 4 times, and lasting 10s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

4.name: Concealment
4.desc: When Trigger enters or extends <color=#FFFFFF>Coordinated Support</color>, while the state is active, the next time other squad members trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus</color>, it will trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Disconnect</color> upon hitting an enemy, dealing additional DMG equal to 200% of Trigger's ATK and inflict Daze equal to 120% of Trigger's Impact. This skill has a relatively high Interrupt Level.

6.name: Beyond the River of the Dead
6.desc: Upon entering the battlefield, Trigger gains 5 <color=#FFFFFF>Armor Break Rounds</color>. For every 25 <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color> consumed, Trigger gains 1 additional <color=#FFFFFF>Armor Break Round</color>, up to a maximum of 5 rounds. While possessing <color=#FFFFFF>Armor Break Rounds</color>, when Trigger hits a target in <color=#FFFFFF>Sniper Stance</color>, 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Armor Break Round</color> is consumed to deal additional <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> equal to 1,200% of Trigger's ATK. <color=#FFFFFF>Armor Break Round</color> DMG is additionally increased by 50%. This effect can trigger once every 0.2s.

yixuan.profileDesc:
Yixuan is the 13th High Preceptor of Yunkui Summit and a Void Hunter-level investigator, officially recognized by Mayor Mayflower.

She was once an orphan, wandering the world with her sister from a young age. Later, the then-High Preceptor of Yunkui Summit took them in, and they became disciples, learning the craft of Yunkui Summit. During this time, Yixuan demonstrated exceptional talent. No matter the technique, she would quickly master it, not only understanding it thoroughly but also creating her own unique techniques. The Qingming Bird was one of the special techniques she and her sister developed together, which helped her eliminate enemies and banish evil spirits in various difficult and dangerous situations. After becoming the sect's High Preceptor, she accepted an invitation from Mayor Mayflower and joined the Hollow Investigative Association as a partnered special investigator.

After becoming High Preceptor, Yixuan took in many talented disciples to continue Yunkui Summit's lineage. However, her approach is rather casual, and often, even when teaching by example, her disciples can only guess her intentions... Yet, Yixuan isn't troubled by this, as she believes there's no standard answer to the so-called "right path." What matters to her is that her disciples find their own "right path." Of course, if they can understand and learn on their own, that's even better. As their Shifu, she simply lets things unfold naturally.

ranks.core:
Yixuan gains extra Sheer Force based on her Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1.
All <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color> Yixuan deals via her skills is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using her Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
When Yixuan accumulates <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink Anomaly Buildup</color>, it uses an independent Anomaly Buildup gauge, and when triggering an Anomaly, she restores an additional 10 Adrenaline. This can trigger once every 10s.
Upon entering combat, Yixuan immediately restores all Adrenaline. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can only trigger once every 180s. Triggering a Perfect Dodge grants an additional 5 Adrenaline and can occur at most once per second.
When she consumes Adrenaline, Yixuan accumulates Technique Points, gaining 0.667 points for each point of Adrenaline consumed. With enough Technique Points, she can trigger an additional Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression. The maximum for Technique Points is 120.
The DMG dealt by Yixuan's Basic Attack: Auric Array, Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption, EX Special Attack, Assist Follow-Up, Chain Attack, and Ultimate increases by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>.
After launching Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression, Yixuan gains one Auric Ink Point. She can spend an Auric Ink Point to launch Basic Attack: Auric Array.
ranks.ability:
When another character in your squad is a <color=#FFFFFF>Stun</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Support</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Defense</color> character:
When a fellow squad member uses an Ultimate, Yixuan continuously recovers 2 Adrenaline for 10s. If Yixuan is switched out by a Perfect Assist, she automatically follows up with a lightning strike attack, dealing DMG equal to 225% of her Sheer Force and restoring an additional 5 Adrenaline.
EX Special Attack: Cloud-Shaper and EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows deal 30% increased DMG to Stunned enemies.
After activating her Ultimate, Yixuan enters the Meditation state, increasing her CRIT DMG by 40% for 15s.

All <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color> Yixuan deals via her skills is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using her Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
When Yixuan accumulates <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink Anomaly Buildup</color>, it uses an independent Anomaly Buildup gauge, and when triggering an Anomaly, she restores an additional 10 Adrenaline. This can trigger once every 10s.
Upon entering combat, Yixuan immediately restores all Adrenaline. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can only trigger once every 180s. Triggering a Perfect Dodge grants an additional 5 Adrenaline and can occur at most once per second.
When she consumes Adrenaline, Yixuan accumulates Technique Points, gaining 0.667 points for each point of Adrenaline consumed. With enough Technique Points, she can trigger an additional Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression. The maximum for Technique Points is 120.
The DMG dealt by Yixuan's Basic Attack: Auric Array, Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption, EX Special Attack, Assist Follow-Up, Chain Attack, and Ultimate increases by <color=#2BAD00>55%</color>.
After launching Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression, Yixuan gains one Auric Ink Point. She can spend an Auric Ink Point to launch Basic Attack: Auric Array.
ranks.ability:
When another character in your squad is a <color=#FFFFFF>Stun</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Support</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Defense</color> character:
When a fellow squad member uses an Ultimate, Yixuan continuously recovers 2 Adrenaline for 10s. If Yixuan is switched out by a Perfect Assist, she automatically follows up with a lightning strike attack, dealing DMG equal to 225% of her Sheer Force and restoring an additional 5 Adrenaline.
EX Special Attack: Cloud-Shaper and EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows deal 30% increased DMG to Stunned enemies.
After activating her Ultimate, Yixuan enters the Meditation state, increasing her CRIT DMG by 40% for 15s.
