1.name: Spiritual Path
1.desc: Upon entering combat, CRIT Rate increases by 10% and immediately gain 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Technique Points</color>. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can only trigger once every 180s. When any squad member lands a hit on an enemy, Yixuan automatically summons an extra lightning strike, dealing DMG equal to 50% of her Sheer Force and restoring 5 additional Adrenaline. This can trigger once every 6s.

2.name: Ward Off Misfortune
2.desc: When an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> deals DMG, it ignores 15% of the target's <color=#FE437E>Ether RES</color>. Triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Qingming Skyshade</color> extends all enemies' Stunned state by 3s. In a single Stun state duration, enemies can only have this effect applied once, and it does not stack with similar effects. Additionally, when using <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression</color>, gain one stack of the <color=#FFFFFF>Condensed Ink</color> effect. After <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows</color>, press the Basic Attack button, or after <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Qingming Eruption - Break</color>, press the Special Attack button to consume one stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Condensed Ink</color> and launch <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Endless Talisman Suppression - Break</color>, dealing DMG up to 1,200% of Sheer Force. Only one stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Condensed Ink</color> can be held at a time.

4.name: The One Path of Mysticism
4.desc: Activating an <color=#FFFFFF> Ultimate</color> grants one stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Tranquility</color>, up to a max of 2 stacks. For each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Tranquility</color>, the next <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Cloud-Shaper</color> DMG and <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows</color> DMG increase by 30%.

6.name: Swift Yet Still
6.desc: After using <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Qingming Skyshade</color>, gain a stack of the <color=#FFFFFF>Regulated Breathing</color> effect. While under this effect, you can ignore the <color=#FFFFFF>Technique Point</color> cost to launch <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression</color> once. The <color=#FFFFFF>Regulated Breathing</color> effect ends after <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression</color> is used. This effect can only be gained once every 30s. Only one stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Regulated Breathing</color> can be held. Additionally, while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Meditation</color> state, Yixuan's Sheer DMG is increased by 20%.

soldier 0.profileDesc:
Anby, the original member of Gentle House.
According to the New Eridu resident records, her identity as "Anby Demara" only exists after joining Gentle House, the name obviously being taken from Nicole. Before registering as an employee of Gentle House, all data relating to Anby is suspiciously blank.
Despite her extreme lack of common sense, Anby is well-versed in matters related to combat and is among the strongest combatants of the Cunning Hares.

Anby's greatest interest is movies, of which she likes an extensive range of genres. Due to an excessive obsession, she tends to take the stories in movies as reality.
Contrary to her seemingly emotionless appearance, Anby is easily moved by movie storylines.
Her favorite food is hamburgers because "they contain protein, carbs, and greens, taste good, and are even affordable — there's nothing else besides hamburgers."

ranks.core:
Soldier 0 - Anby deals <color=#2BAD00>12.5%</color> more DMG to enemies marked with <color=#FFFFFF>Silver Star</color>. When an enemy is afflicted with <color=#FFFFFF>Silver Star</color>, they take additional CRIT DMG from <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershocks</color>, equal to <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> of Soldier 0 - Anby's CRIT DMG. When marked with a Silver Star, DMG from allies' <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershocks</color> builds <color=#FFFFFF> Silver Star</color> charge on the enemy. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
The Aftershock CRIT DMG bonus from Silver Star is further increased by 5% of Soldier 0 - Anby's CRIT DMG. When an enemy afflicted with <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color> is defeated, automatically unleash <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Thunder Smite</color> on the nearest enemy target.

When another character in your squad is a <color=#FFFFFF>Stun</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Support</color> character:

Soldier 0 - Anby's <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> are treated as <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> DMG.

2.name: Fail-Safe Protocol
2.desc:
Soldier 0 - Anby's CRIT Rate increases by 12%. When she uses her <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, she gains 6 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Thunder's Cry</color> (max 6 stacks). With <color=#FFFFFF>Thunder's Cry</color>, when using <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Azure Flash</color> to hit an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color>, it will consume 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Thunder's Cry</color> instead. Only 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Thunder's Cry</color> will be consumed when a single use of a skill hits multiple enemies, and consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Thunder's Cry</color> will still activate the additional DMG from <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color>.
After activating potential, every 3 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Thunder's Cry</color> consumed, the next Special Attack: Azure Flash - Boundary will be activated faster.

4.name: Silver Reverb

6.name: Prequel Protagonist
6.desc: Upon triggering 6 instances of <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color>'s additional DMG, an electromagnetic vortex will be generated, dealing 1,000% of Soldier 0 - Anby's ATK as <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> against the target and surrounding enemies. This DMG is considered <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> DMG.

ju fufu.profileDesc:
Ju Fufu, a rare tiger Thiren of New Eridu. She looks small and is still young, but she's the most senior disciple of Suibian Temple and one of Yixuan's first disciples.

"Able to deal with anything," "can even make Shifu listen," "super patient and meticulous teacher," "has great taste when choosing restaurants for teambuilding."
—Yunkui Summit trainee performance review, peer evaluation

"Always messing up the tasks given by Shifu," "doesn't command respect in speech or combat," "doesn't know how to act tough against bad guys," "juniors are more skilled."
—Yunkui Summit trainee performance review, self-evaluation

"'The most skilled senior ever who can do anything, a righteous hero with righteous might' is what I heard her say when I passed by her room. Hm... I concur."
—Yunkui Summit trainee performance review, Shifu's evaluation

Other: I suggest you suggest Yunkui Summit improve their network security to avoid the risk of disciples' personal data being stolen or leaked.

ranks.core:
When Ju Fufu isn't using Hu Wei, it will automatically attack enemies and gain <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color> upon hitting them.
When Hu Wei hits an enemy and has at least 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color>, and Ju Fufu is not the currently active character, Ju Fufu will launch <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Suppressing Tiger Cauldron</color> centered around the target enemy. Upon activation, all squad members gain the <color=#FFFFFF>Tiger's Roar</color> effect: CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>, and when Ju Fufu's initial ATK is greater than or equal to 2,800, every additional 100 ATK further increases CRIT DMG by 5%, up to a maximum additional increase of 30%.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Tiger's Roar</color> state, character <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%/20%</color>.
The <color=#FFFFFF>Tiger's Roar</color> state lasts for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. While Ju Fufu is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Tiger's Roar</color> state, Impact increases by <color=#2BAD00>25</color>.

alice.profileDesc:
Alice Thymefield, a new member of Spook Shack, is a young lady from the prestigious Thymefield family of New Eridu.

Alice has studied fencing and Ether science since childhood, showing exceptional talent in both fields. She currently attends Celestia School for Girls, a subsidiary of High Ambitions Academy, where she's a model student excelling in both academics and conduct. It is predicted that she will one day inherit the family business and become a next-generation Ether scholar of New Eridu.

She places extreme importance on order and patterns, showing an almost obsessive pursuit of symmetry in particular. This even affects her aesthetic judgment, making symmetry the primary criterion in determining whether something is beautiful or ugly.

Furthermore, she's easily frightened, with practically zero resistance to ghost stories and supernatural tales. Despite this, she seems to show considerable interest in encountering such phenomena. Suggestion: Master can use ghost stories as a topic of conversation with her. No matter how much she initially refuses, it is likely that she will eventually come closer to investigate.

yuzuha.profileDesc:
Ukinami Yuzuha, a resident of Waifei Peninsula's Failume Heights, currently attends a low-tuition company affiliated school in the city. Aside from being part of the Inter-Knot subforum Spook Shack, she's not affiliated with any other groups — though in New Eridu, such forums aren't typically seen as formal organizations, and are, instead, more like hobby clubs.
Yuzuha is the adopted daughter of Li Baorong, owner of the Mystic Wares Porcelume store. Word around Failume Heights is that Baorong lost his wife and two daughters when the old capital fell. In the years that followed, he took in five children. Yuzuha is the second oldest, with an older brother, a younger brother, and two younger sisters. The family lived on the second floor above the store, and with just two bedrooms, Yuzuha shared one with her sisters, while the boys stayed with Baorong. Now that her older brother has moved out and she mostly stays in the school dorm, the apartment feels a bit less crowded. But on weekends and holidays, Yuzuha usually returns from school to help her father at the store.
Even as a child, Yuzuha showed a surprising level of maturity. Her eloquence and cheerful nature have made her a favorite among neighbors — and a hit with the kids around Waifei Peninsula and Sailume Bay.
On the Spook Shack forum, Yuzuha goes by the username "Yuzupepper." In addition to her real-life friends Manato and Alice, she is also close with two other users known as "Night Emissary" and "Strawberry Parfait" on the forums.

When using <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to charge for up to 0.8 seconds. Releasing <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or reaching full charge fires an extra powerful shell at the enemy. For every 0.4s charged, Yuzuha consumes 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Sugar Point</color> to fire an additional powerful shell, each dealing 300% of her ATK as <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>. If any powerful shell from <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot</color> hits an enemy, all squad members' <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG Multiplier increases by 105% for 40s, and stacking up to 3 times, with each stack duration being calculated separately. In addition, if the powerful shell hits an enemy under <color=#FFFFFF>Sweet Scare</color>, it'll trigger 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max</color> attack. If Yuzuha is attacked while charging, she will automatically dodge the attack and immediately unleash the max-charged attack.

pan yinhu.profileDesc:
Pan Yinhu, disciple of Yunkui Summit, serves as both the head chef and financial manager of Suibian Temple. He's proficient in martial arts, and an expert in pressure-point techniques.
As the one managing Suibian Temple's money, he's a master at keeping costs down and can bargain a 5,000 Denny piece of meat down to 500. If he can make something at home, he refuses to purchase it at a store, and no matter which big supermarket or shop you name, he's got a coupon for it tucked in his pocket.
Thanks to him, the members of Suibian Temple enjoy delicious yet budget-friendly meals every day. As the head of the kitchen, he demands precise flavor profiles and pays keen attention to his friends' opinions.
What's more, given his years of frugality, it's safe to assume that both the group's treasury and his secret piggy bank have ballooned to jaw-dropping levels.

ye shunguang.profileDesc:
Ye Shunguang is the Sword Keeper of Yunkui Summit's treasured Qingming Sword, a disciple of Yixuan, and the younger sister of Ye Shiyuan, as well as a swordswoman blessed with extraordinary talent.
She enjoyed a happy childhood until the fall of the old capital, when her parents lost their lives rescuing others, bringing all her happiness to an abrupt end.
From then on, she relied solely on her brother — up until Yixuan took them in, bringing them into Yunkui Summit. Later, she was chosen by the Qingming Sword, taking up the mantle and duty of Sword Keeper.

Rumor has it that the Qingming Sword's favor is less a blessing and more a kind of curse. Though it gives its Sword Keeper Void Hunter level power, it extracts a harsh cost — the loss of one's memories and five senses.
In order to subdue this side effect, Yixuan Shifu crafted a custom sword case for Ye Shunguang. It appears effective for the moment, but the true nature of the weapon is still shrouded in mystery.

ranks.core:
When not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state and with fewer than 6 points of Qingming Sword Force, certain attacks slowly build <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>. Whenever <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> is gained by any means, each 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> that exceeds the limit is converted into 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Bearer</color>, stacking up to 3 times. Upon leaving the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, all <color=#FFFFFF>Bearer</color> stacks are consumed to grant the same number of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> stacks.
Upon entering the battlefield, gain <color=#FFFFFF>Unity</color>, increasing CRIT Rate by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> and DMG by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Chasing Storms</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Entry Skill: Illuminating Darkness</color> is unleashed, Ye Shunguang enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state and activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> has the same duration as <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color>. The duration lasts 16s, and the duration timer pauses while she is off-field. During the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, Ye Shunguang's skills are enhanced, all <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> dealt by her skills becomes <color=#F0D12B>Honed Edge DMG</color>.
While <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> is active, when an enemy enters <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color>, they gain a Veil Vulnerability effect based on their current Stun DMG Multiplier. During this, when Ye Shunguang deals DMG to enemies with her skills, enemy Stun DMG Multiplier is ignored and replaced with the Veil Vulnerability bonus. Veil Vulnerability caps at 110%. The effect is removed when <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> ends.
ranks.ability:
When another character in your squad is a <color=#FFFFFF>Support</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Defense</color> character:
When a squadmate activates any <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, gain 3 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>. If already in the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, this is instead converted into 3 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Bearer</color>.

manato.profileDesc:
Komano Manato, a member of Spook Shack and an exceptionally reliable person. Having lost his family in the fall of the old capital, he grew up alone in Waifei Peninsula until the day he happened to adopt two street children, A-Cing and A-Yuet. Since then, the three have lived as a family, depending on one another. It may be a young household, but to Manato, nothing matters more than looking after them.
Manato is currently enrolled at a company affiliated school in the city, where rumors paint him as the terrifying "school delinquent." The label likely comes from his intimidating appearance, though in reality, he's far more soft-hearted and generous than he seems.
At first, Manato really did want to do something to clear up the misunderstanding about being a delinquent, but for various reasons, his efforts didn't make much of an impact. Still, his optimism soon led him to realize that the title wasn't all bad. It let him dodge unnecessary social events, live without being bothered by strangers, and even leverage the "delinquent" image to sniff out stories of school ghost tales, all while standing up for classmates suffering from actual bullying.
But when it comes to grades, he really does live up to the "school delinquent" label of a company affiliated school student.

ranks.core:
Manato gains extra Sheer Force based on his Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1.
All <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> Manato deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using his Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
When Manato uses <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice</color> or a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>, he accumulates <color=#FFFFFF>Blazing Heart</color>, up to a maximum of 100 points. At 75 <color=#FFFFFF>Blazing Heart</color>, Manato enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Molten Edge</color> state. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Molten Edge</color> state, Manato consumes 3.3 <color=#FFFFFF>Blazing Heart</color> per second. When <color=#FFFFFF>Blazing Heart</color> is fully depleted, he exits <color=#FFFFFF>Molten Edge</color>.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Molten Edge</color> state, Manato's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color> are enhanced, and he can use <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Fall</color>.
When consuming HP during <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Blazing Wind - Misty Slash</color> or during the consecutive slashes from an <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, that attack's CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color>, and the Adrenaline Generation Rate increases by 100%.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Molten Edge</color> state, Manato's CRIT Rate increases by 10%, and his <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>.
ranks.ability:
When another character in your squad is a <color=#FFFFFF>Support</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Stun</color> character:
When Manato uses his Ultimate, he gains 8 stacks of Remnant Flame, and when using a Chain Attack, he gains 4 stacks of Remnant Flame, lasting 60s, stacking up to 20 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration. While launching <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Blazing Wind - Misty Slash</color> or during the consecutive slashes of an <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, if his HP is below 100% of Max HP, one stack of Remnant Flame is consumed to restore 2% of his Max HP.

lucia.profileDesc:
Lucia, a member of Spook Shack, goes by the online name "Night Emissary." She's a backpacker, an Ethereal story enthusiast, and a connoisseur of late-night food stalls.

Records show that Lucia hails from a tribe living on the outskirts of the city. Legend has it their ancestors once encountered an Ethereal called the "Night Horror" (absent from the Hollow Investigative Association archives), which left them with a strange gift: Ethereals tend not to notice them. The cost, though, is that they dream of the Night Horror at night, and under its influence, they sleepwalk into Hollows, where corruption awaits.
Because of this, the tribe took on the role of Nightwatchers. They rest during the day and hunt deep in the night, avoiding the Night Horror's pull. And if anyone must sleep at night, their family will keep vigil at their side until dawn.

Lucia grew up surrounded by her kin, and even after arriving in New Eridu, she has kept to the Nightwatcher tradition of staying awake through the night and watching over her cherished friends, shielding them from the Night Horror's reach.
Master, if you hear a knock at your window late at night, don't be alarmed. It may just be a sleepless night guardian stopping by to say hello.

Additional note: Lucia's pet is "Chestnut," a small, friendly Hati. It once lived in the Hollow's outskirts, but has since moved deeper inside. Even I can no longer detect its exact whereabouts.

kit.abilityName: Additional Ability: Ballad of the Long Night

ranks.core:
When entering the battlefield, Lucia immediately gains 60 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color>. If her <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> reaches 100 upon activating a <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>, she enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state.
When entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, it triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> and simultaneously activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>. seed.profileDesc:
Seed, heavy weapons specialist of New Eridu Defense Force, Obsidian Division, Obol Squad. Her real name is Flora. The codename "Seed" was passed down from her guardian, the combat-grade Intelligent Construct formerly known by the same name, who now goes by "Seed Sr."

According to multiple sources, Seed is an unidentified orphan Seed Sr. rescued from Hollow Zero during the fall of the old capital. Seed Sr. adopted her and raised her alone in the Defense Force dormitories.
A few years ago, Seed Sr. successfully applied to join Obol Squad, but not long after, he passed away due to irreversible damage to his logic core. As a result, Seed took his place in the squad. Any voice lines heard from Seed Sr. today are system-preloaded audio files.

Seed possesses an extraordinary gift for mechanical engineering and research, capable of designing and building inventions far beyond the imagination of most. She also has an exceptional adaptability for Ether, able to push Seed Sr.'s combat capabilities to the limit by piloting him, through remote control, and by using custom combat modules.

And so, despite her extraordinarily substandard physical capabilities and entirely mysterious origins, the military still gave tacit approval for her to serve as an elite soldier.

Seed behaves quite differently from most people in everyday situations. She uses Seed Sr.'s cockpit as her bed, prefers confined spaces, and strongly dislikes talking to or interacting with anyone outside her immediate circle. Her logic jumps wildly, making meaningful conversation difficult.

The good news? For some reason, she's taken a special liking to you, Master, and the second assistant. You've been spared the long ordeal of earning her trust — and you don't have to worry about her occasional bouts of destructive behavior turning your way. Congratulations.

Suggestion: Focus on topics like flowers and robots — her favorite things — when engaging in conversation. Stay calm when parts of her logic or meaning don't make sense; treating such moments as normal can help strengthen your bond with her.

ranks.core:
The <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> teammate with the highest initial ATK is considered Seed's <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color>.
When the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color> unleashes an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, Seed gains <color=#FFFFFF>Onslaught</color> status, increasing Seed's ATK by <color=#2BAD00>100</color> and CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>. When Seed unleashes an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color> gains <color=#FFFFFF>Direct Strike</color> status, increasing the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color>'s ATK by <color=#2BAD00>100</color> and CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Direct Strike</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Onslaught</color> are both active, Seed and the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color> simultaneously gain <color=#FFFFFF>Besiege</color> status, increasing DMG dealt by <color=#2BAD00>12.5%</color>.
<color=#FFFFFF>Onslaught</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Direct Strike</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Besiege</color> buffs can all take effect when the character is the current active character. When switching to inactive, the buffs remain until the character goes off-field or 3s after the switch. When the character returns to being the active character, the buffs re-activate.
Upon entering the battlefield with a <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color>, Seed immediately gains <color=#FFFFFF>Onslaught</color> status and <color=#FFFFFF>Besiege</color> status, while the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color> immediately gains <color=#FFFFFF>Direct Strike</color> status and <color=#FFFFFF>Besiege</color> status.
<color=#FFFFFF>Direct Strike</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Onslaught</color> status last for 40s, and repeated triggers refresh the duration.
When the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color> consumes Energy as the active character or when Seed consumes Energy, for every 1 point of Energy consumed, Seed recovers 0.5 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color>.
ranks.ability:
When another <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> Character is in your squad:
When Seed deals DMG as the active character, restore 2 Energy to the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color>. This effect can trigger once every 1s.
Seed's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Clockwork Garden - Bloom!</color> deal 30% increased DMG and ignore 25% of enemy <color=#2EB6FF>Electric RES</color>.

banyue.profileDesc:
Banyue is an Intelligent Construct who runs a martial arts school in Waifei, known to many as "Banyue Shifu." He has lived for a long time, his stone-lion-like presence commanding respect. A martial arts expert of great skill, he shares a long-standing friendship with Yunkui Summit's current High Preceptor, Yixuan.

As a martial master, Banyue is quiet but dependable. His methods and beliefs are rooted in tradition, and he disciplines his students with strict yet thoughtful guidance, teaching them not just how to fight, but how to learn. Known as a true master of the martial arts, in battle, he can assume a special form known as the Visage of Wrath to vanquish all evil.

A long inhabitant of Waifei, Banyue is quiet and even-tempered. He doesn't express emotions easily and has the manner of someone from another era. Knowing he's out of touch with modern trends, he's been secretly trying to learn the latest internet slang... yet his half-baked grasp of it tends to end in funny little misunderstandings.

Banyue also appears to have a strange liking for round things — stone balls, spherical bollards, and the like. If the conversation ever goes silent while you're alone with him, bringing up something spherical usually does the trick.

kit.coreName: Core Passive: One With the Mountains

ranks.core:
Banyue gains extra Sheer Force based on his Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing his Sheer Force by 0.1.
All <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> Banyue deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using his Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
When Banyue enters the battlefield, he immediately recovers 60 Adrenaline. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
Banyue can recover <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color> through the following methods:
Recover 0.5 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color> for every point of Adrenaline consumed;
Recover 4 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color> upon activating <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>;
Recover 4 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color> when parrying an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Immovable Mountain</color>, and recover 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color> instead upon triggering a Perfect Block, up to once every 1s;
Recover 4 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color> upon triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, up to once every 1s.
Banyue can have up to 150 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>. When he possesses at least 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>, Banyue can enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state by using <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Immolate</color>. While in <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, Banyue can no longer gain <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>. After Banyue uses <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain</color>, he exits the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state.
When entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, Banyue gains 4 <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color>. If Banyue has <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color>, launching an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> no longer consumes Adrenaline, instead consuming 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color> and restoring 10 Adrenaline. Upon exiting the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, remove all <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color>.
When possessing <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color> in <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to launch four different <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attacks</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain</color> in a fixed sequence.
When Banyue uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, he increases his Sheer Force by <color=#2BAD00>150</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> by <color=#2BAD00>18%</color>, and CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>18%</color> for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
ranks.ability:
When another character in your squad is a <color=#FFFFFF>Support</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Stun</color> character:
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, when Banyue consumes <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color> to unleash an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> through a Basic Attack branch or quick input commands, he gains one stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Vidyaraja</color>. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Vidyaraja</color> increases his <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> by 5%, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 8s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

dialyn.profileDesc:
Dialyn works as a customer service representative for TOPS' Cross-Department Customer Service Center, though few know her other identity — a Krampus Compliance Authority Judge.

She calls herself TOPS' top-rated representative, yet she also tops the list for the most complaints in the department. Despite never flaunting her authority as a Judge, she always delivers verdicts that cut closest to the truth.

Dialyn was born with the ability to hear the voices of those on the brink of death within the Hollows — a talent that's unmatched. Yet to a young Dialyn, it was a tormenting curse.

Be it gift or curse, she has long turned it into a blade for discerning the truth. Despite the trials and tribulations she's borne, she's come far.

ranks.core:
Upon entering the battlefield, Dialyn starts with 60 <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color>. If her initial CRIT Rate surpasses 50%, her Impact increases by <color=#2BAD00>1.4</color> for each additional 1%, up to a maximum increase of 100.
After using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rock</color>, the next <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> becomes <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Scissors</color> for 8s.
After using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Scissors</color>, the next <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> becomes <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Paper!</color> for 8s.
When <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Paper!</color> hits an enemy, it applies the <color=#FFFFFF>Malicious Complaint</color> effect. While under <color=#FFFFFF>Malicious Complaint</color>, if the enemy becomes Stunned, the Stun duration is extended by 2s, and Stun DMG Multiplier increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>. Before recovering from Stun, <color=#FFFFFF>Malicious Complaint</color> can trigger on the same target only once. The Stun duration bonus does not stack with similar effects. When an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Malicious Complaint</color> recovers from being Stunned, the effect ends.
While in combat, Dialyn gains 0.6 <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color> per second. When a heavy attack of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rock</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Scissors</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Paper!</color> hits enemies, she gains 7.5 <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color>. Each use of a skill can grant this bonus only once, up to a maximum of 120.
With at least 90 <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color>, when Dialyn triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> window using <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Welcome Mat</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Get Lost!</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist: Forward Call</color>, the next character to switch in will have their <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> upgraded to an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>. When an ally launches an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> this way, Dialyn consumes 60 <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color>.
With at least 90 <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color>, when Dialyn hits an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Get Lost!</color> and doesn't trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> window, she consumes 90 <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color> to forcibly trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> window. The next character to switch in will have their <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> upgraded to an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>.
Each time <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color> reaches 90 or an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> is activated, Dialyn obtains 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Customer Complaint</color>. A maximum of 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Customer Complaint</color> can be held at a time.
ranks.ability:
When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Rupture</color> character:
Dialyn's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> CRIT DMG is increased by 50%.
When an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> is activated, all squad members gain the <color=#FFFFFF>Overwhelmingly Positive</color> effect. While <color=#FFFFFF>Overwhelmingly Positive</color> is active, DMG dealt is increased by 40% for 15s. When Dialyn uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> while <color=#FFFFFF>Overwhelmingly Positive</color> is active, if the remaining duration of <color=#FFFFFF>Overwhelmingly Positive</color> is less than 35s, its duration is extended by 10s.
When a heavy attack from <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rock</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Scissors</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Paper!</color> hits, additional DMG is dealt based on the previous squad member's Specialty:
If the squad member is an <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> Agent, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rock</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Scissors</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Paper!</color> deal additional DMG equal to 320% of that <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> Agent's ATK.
If the squad member is a <color=#FFFFFF>Rupture</color> Agent, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rock</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Scissors</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Paper!</color> deal additional DMG equal to 400% of that <color=#FFFFFF>Rupture</color> Agent's Sheer Force.

sunna.profileDesc:
Sunna is a member of the Angels of Delusion idol group and the composer behind all of the group's music. Maintaining top-tier songwriting while keeping pace with rehearsals and stage performances is anything but easy for her. When the pressure piles up, she occasionally employs the tactic of "retreat is the best option" to dodge Captain Nangong Yu's brutal scheduling.
Note: Reliable intelligence suggests that this tactic works largely because Nangong Yu intentionally lets it slide.

Sunna and Nangong Yu, another member of the Angels of Delusion, have known each other since they were young and grew up together. While they appear to always squabble, the two are in fact deeply dependent on one another. When it comes to music, Sunna shares a strong connection with their final member, Aria. As Aria puts it, the two frequently spend whole days in the studio discussing melodies for new songs, only to drift off to sleep without even realizing it, heads resting against each other.

Sunna is fairly introverted and prefers spending time alone over group activities. That said, her two teammates know her weaknesses all too well — she finds it hard to say no and can't handle praise — and are helping her gradually overcome her social anxiety through desensitization training (progress: about 25%).

While most fans see Sunna's "hopeless" side as endearing, she herself seems eager to tear off that label and become a confident, "proper idol." As the creative force behind the music, she often wants to flee the stage — yet in truth, she's not as indifferent to performing as she claims to be.
Evidence: A sticky note by Sunna's bedside that reads "I can't disappoint the fans. I need to give them my very best on stage!"

ranks.core:
Characters in the <color=#FFFFFF>Angelic Chord-ination</color> state gain increased ATK, equal to <color=#FFFFFF>30%</color> of Sunna's initial ATK, up to a maximum of <color=#2BAD00>525</color> ATK. When Sunna's initial ATK reaches 1,750, the ATK bonus granted to all squad members reaches its maximum.
When attacks from Basic Attack: Naughty Cat Spotted, EX Special Attack: Bubblegum Barrage, EX Special Attack: Special Photography Technique, Chain Attack: Don't Mess With the Cat, or Ultimate: Smash It All! hit an enemy, apply <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> to the target for 12s. While Sunna is the currently active character, the duration of <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> is continuously refreshed. Some normal enemies affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> show reduced aggression toward Sunna.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> characters in the squad continuously land attacks on enemies affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> is triggered and removed:
When triggered by an <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> character, deals the Agent's Attribute DMG equal to <color=#2BAD00>150%</color> of ATK to enemies in an area.
When triggered by an <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> character, deals the Agent's Attribute DMG equal to <color=#2BAD00>240%</color> of ATK to enemies in an area. This DMG is guaranteed to CRIT, and the CRIT DMG is increased by <color=#2BAD00>80%</color>.
DMG dealt by <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> is treated as DMG dealt by the triggering Agent.
When multiple enemies on the field have <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color>, only the primary attack target's <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> is triggered. Upon triggering, <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> is removed from all enemies on the field.
When an enemy is Stunned, the number of attacks required to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> is significantly reduced.

aria.profileDesc:
Aria is the lead vocalist and center of the Angels of Delusion. Bright and full of energy, she always shines on stage, bringing warmth and strength to all Delulus.
She has a near-perfect voice, even though she was never professionally trained. At first, Aria only sang because she loved her idol, the retired songstress Cersea, copying her performances and singing along, until she realized she had a gift for song of her own.
Though Aria's vocal skills are undeniably professional, she lacks a solid foundation in dance. Even with dedicated practice, she can still get flustered when faced with more complex moves. Still, fans deeply appreciate her attitude of "even if I can't dance well, I'll still give it everything I've got."
"Pushing herself to the limit, wrestling with her own limbs to try and keep up with the rhythm... that's our Angels of Delusion lead vocalist!" —One Delulu sobbing after a show.

nangong yu.profileDesc:
Nangong Yu, the captain and choreographer of the idol group the "Angels of Delusion," is a rare prodigy blessed with exceptional Ether aptitude, a sharp business acumen, and outstanding idol talent.

Though she always presents herself with a laid-back air — teasing her teammates and joking around — she consistently receives the fewest negative reviews in the group. Although she often claims that her dream is merely "borrowed," she pours far more effort and emotion into this small stage than anyone would believe.

Nangong possesses a rare gift for making the difficult look effortless — whether it's dancing, rapping, making investments, or reading people. That gift once served as the mask that allowed her to easily play the role of "captain," yet it also kept her isolated from her true desires.

Yet whether it started as responsibility toward a close friend or later turned into an irreplaceable love for the stage, beneath the stage lights and the audience's gaze she has already forged those borrowed sparks into a light of her own.

A single enemy can have up to 4 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color>.
If <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> reaches the maximum stacks and the enemy is afflicted with an <color=#FE437E>Ether</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical</color>, <color=#98EFF0>Ice</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind</color> Anomaly, or if the enemy has <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> and recovers from being Stunned, all <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> stacks will be cleared.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> is cleared, if the enemy is suffering an aforementioned Attribute Anomaly, Nangong Yu triggers an instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG on the target, dealing an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG equal to <color=#FE437E>720%</color>/<color=#2EB6FF>360%</color>/<color=#FF5521>900%</color>/<color=#F0D12B>63%</color>/<color=#98EFF0>90%</color>/<color=#A6C5FD>36%</color> of the original Attribute Anomaly DMG. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> on the enemy increases this <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG ratio by an additional 25%. During the same Stun period, once <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> has been cleared, the enemy cannot gain <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> again.

When <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> is cleared, if the enemy is suffering an aforementioned Attribute Anomaly, Nangong Yu triggers an instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG on the target, dealing an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG equal to <color=#FE437E>720%</color>/<color=#2EB6FF>360%</color>/<color=#FF5521>900%</color>/<color=#F0D12B>63%</color>/<color=#98EFF0>90%</color>/<color=#A6C5FD>36%</color> of the original Attribute Anomaly DMG. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> on the enemy increases this <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG ratio by an additional 25%. During the same Stun period, once <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> has been cleared, the enemy cannot gain <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> again.
When Nangong Yu's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love</color> hits an enemy, her Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>, and her Daze dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>12.5%</color>, and the whole squad's DMG dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
While in combat, Nangong Yu restores 3.8 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color>/s. When any squad member inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, Nangong Yu restores an additional 12 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color>. This effect can trigger once every 6s.
Nangong Yu can have up to 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color>, and starts with 30 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color> upon entering the battlefield.
ranks.ability:
When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> character or shares the same Faction:
Any squad member's attack against a Stunned enemy has 30% increased Anomaly Buildup. <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attacks</color> against a Stunned enemy have an additional 30% increased Anomaly Buildup.
When any squad member Stuns an enemy, Nangong Yu gains 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Dance Prowess</color>, up to a maximum of 2 stacks, lasting 15s, repeated triggers reset the duration. With <color=#FFFFFF>Dance Prowess</color>, when a heavy attack from Nangong Yu's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist: Emergency Save</color> hits an enemy that is both Stunned and affected by an Attribute Anomaly, 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Dance Prowess</color> is consumed to trigger the special <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> effect <color=#FFFFFF>Polarity Disorder</color> against all enemies who meet the conditions. This deals DMG equal to 25% of the original <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG, and triggers the previous squad member's <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Polarity Disorder</color> does not clear the target's Attribute Anomaly. If the skill fails to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Polarity Disorder</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dance Prowess</color> will not be consumed. When Nangong Yu has <color=#FFFFFF>Dance Prowess</color>, the next time she switches to the field, she will immediately perform the first charged hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact</color>, which will always trigger precise charging.
When any squad member Stuns an enemy, Nangong Yu's next <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> will not consume Energy. This effect lasts 15s and can trigger once every 15s.
When Nangong Yu and Aria are in the same squad, if Aria's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch</color> heavy attack hits an enemy that is both Stunned and affected by an Attribute Anomaly, and Nangong Yu fully participates in the attack, 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Dance Prowess</color> will also be consumed to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Polarity Disorder</color> on all enemies who meet the conditions.
When the third hit of Nangong Yu's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Meteor Shower</color> hits an enemy, the enemy suffers <color=#FFFFFF>Misstep</color>. Under this effect, Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 30% and when an enemy becomes Stunned, their Stun duration increases by 3s. Before recovering from Stun, <color=#FFFFFF>Misstep</color> can only trigger once on the same target. The increased Stun duration cannot stack with similar effects. When an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Misstep</color> recovers from Stun, the <color=#FFFFFF>Misstep</color> effect ends.

When <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> is cleared, if the enemy is suffering an aforementioned Attribute Anomaly, Nangong Yu triggers an instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG on the target, dealing an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG equal to <color=#FE437E>720%</color>/<color=#2EB6FF>360%</color>/<color=#FF5521>900%</color>/<color=#F0D12B>63%</color>/<color=#98EFF0>90%</color>/<color=#A6C5FD>36%</color> of the original Attribute Anomaly DMG. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> on the enemy increases this <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG ratio by an additional 25%. During the same Stun period, once <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> has been cleared, the enemy cannot gain <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> again.
When Nangong Yu's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love</color> hits an enemy, her Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>35%</color>, and her Daze dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>, and the whole squad's DMG dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
While in combat, Nangong Yu restores 3.8 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color>/s. When any squad member inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, Nangong Yu restores an additional 12 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color>. This effect can trigger once every 6s.
Nangong Yu can have up to 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color>, and starts with 30 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color> upon entering the battlefield.

cissia.profileDesc:
Cissia, a case specialist serving under the New Eridu Public Security Commissioner, is currently campaigning to become the new second-floor roommate at Random Play.

More than the danger of the mission itself, what she fears most is a call from her superior. The professionalism she shows in her actions is far more dependable than how she looks or the way she talks. Relying only on instinct and her senses, she can still make the right call.

She may claim to be a selfish, instinct-driven "bad guy," but the choices she makes often carry a faint glimmer of humanity beyond personal gain. She scoffs at order and justice, yet can become the sharpest blade in the hunt for the worst criminals.

But whether it's the lies she tells to protect herself, the fangs she shows when she bites back, or that wild philosophy of "survive and profit," Cissia has turned them all into a shield to protect the few things she still has. No matter what past or shackles she carries, she has already decided to make her stand here.

starlight billy.profileDesc:
Billy Kid, an AI construct that has passed the forbidden fruit test, is essentially a self-aware machine. 
True to his name, despite having the appearance of a robot, he is quite childlike.
He's a big fan of the visual FX show "Starlight Knight" and wishes to be a hero like the main characters of the show. He often refers to himself as a Starlight Knight and imitates the lines in the show.
Such behavior appears to be only for comedic effect, however.
"Don't make me sound like an idiot! I'm obviously very smart!" — Billy.

1.name: Heroic Entrance
1.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Knight's Resolve</color> restores an additional 60 Adrenaline upon entering the battlefield. Hitting an enemy with an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> causes Starlight - Billy's DMG to ignore 18% <color=#F0D12B>Physical RES</color> for 45s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.

2.name: Wasteland Automaton
2.desc: Increases the DMG dealt by <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Starlight Knight Flying Kick</color> by 50%. Activating <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rocking Footwork</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: High-Traction Wheels</color>, or hitting a Stunned enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Drive Suppression</color> grants the <color=#FFFFFF>Turbocharged</color> effect: <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Drive Suppression</color> consumes this effect to immediately follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie</color>, and increases that instance's CRIT DMG by 50%. Only 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Turbocharged</color> can be held.

4.name: Flames of Justice
4.desc: While in combat, each use of <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Drive Suppression</color> increases Starlight - Billy's CRIT DMG by 8%, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 45s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. If HP is below 35% and Starlight - Billy is not the active character, he continuously recovers HP, up to 35%.

6.name: Starlight Knight
6.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Starlight Knight Flying Kick</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight</color>'s Sheer DMG increases by 18%. Landing the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Knight's Technique</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Knight's Swagger</color> grants 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Brilliant Starlight</color>, stacking up to 6 times, and gaining at most 1 stack per skill use. When using <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Starlight Knight Flying Kick</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight</color>, consumes up to 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Brilliant Starlight</color>, with each stack consumed causing that skill's final hit to deal 100% Sheer Force as additional <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

promeia.profileDesc:
Promeia, a Judge of the Krampus Compliance Authority, is primarily responsible for carrying out "executions."

Unlike the other Judges in Krampus, each with their own strong personalities, Promeia feels more like an iceberg lurking beneath the surface. Quiet and reserved, she seems to have no personal interests or hobbies.

For the majority within the TOPS Alliance, avoiding any involvement with her is a given. If their misdeeds are exposed and they end up under Krampus scrutiny, the first thing those anxious rulebreakers pray for is that Promeia won't be handling their case.

There's a rumor that circulates quietly within the company, but no one dares talk about it openly. Before joining the Krampus Compliance Authority, Promeia came from the infamous Sweepers, an Outer Ring group that served Calydon and specialized in eliminating "unstable elements."

ranks.core:
If Promeia's initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 150, each additional point increases her Anomaly Proficiency by 1.5 and increases the whole squad's <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG by 0.35%.
Promeia gains a set amount of <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color> when her attacks hit enemies. When squad members trigger <color=#98EFF0>Freeze</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color>, when the enemy is inflicted with <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color>, or when Promeia triggers <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow</color>, she gains an additional 5/5/5/10 <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>, up to a maximum of 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>.
When a squad member triggers and hits an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, Promeia gains an additional 15 <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color> reaches at least 50, 50 <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color> is consumed and converted into 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color>, up to a maximum of 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color>.
Upon entering the battlefield, Promeia gains 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color>.
When the finishing move of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment</color> hits an enemy afflicted with <color=#98EFF0>Ice Anomaly</color>, <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire Anomaly</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Anomaly</color>, it triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> once, dealing <color=#2BAD00>330%</color> Attribute Anomaly DMG of the corresponding attribute. The skill consumes 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color> upon activation.
When Promeia triggers and hits an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, she gains an additional 100 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s. Using <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Glaciating Impalement</color> grants <color=#FFFFFF>Frost Oath</color>. With <color=#FFFFFF>Frost Oath</color>, after using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Hanging Judgment</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Glaciating Impalement</color>, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to consume <color=#FFFFFF>Frost Oath</color> and immediately follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Execution - Layered Frost</color>. Only 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Frost Oath</color> can be held.
ranks.ability:
When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Support</color> character:
When using an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, Promeia's <color=#98EFF0>Ice Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> increases by 30% for 30s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.
When any squad member applies the <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> effect to an enemy, its duration is increased by 3s.
When Promeia's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> hits an enemy, it inflicts <color=#FFFFFF>Presumption of Guilt</color>. When any squad member triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> on a target with <color=#FFFFFF>Presumption of Guilt</color>, it ignores 40% of the target's DEF. <color=#FFFFFF>Presumption of Guilt</color> lasts 30s, and repeated triggers refresh the duration.

1.name: Innocent Idealism
1.desc: When Promeia uses <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Glaciating Impalement</color>, she gains an additional effect: if <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color> points are not at maximum, gain 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color>. This effect can trigger once after using <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Glaciating Impalement</color>. When any squad member triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> on enemies with <color=#FFFFFF>Presumption of Guilt</color>, it ignores an additional 20% DEF.

2.name: Faltering Conviction
2.desc: Promeia's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 40. The multiplier of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> triggered by consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color> increases by 120%.

4.name: Ruthless Accusation
4.desc: When Promeia triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, she restores 5 <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s.

6.name: To Be Continued
6.desc: When Promeia consumes <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color> to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, it triggers an additional special <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> effect, dealing Attribute Anomaly DMG of the corresponding attribute at a fixed 200% multiplier. 5 <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color> and 100 Decibels are also restored. This effect can trigger at most once every 15s. In addition, Attribute Anomaly DMG and <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG dealt by Promeia ignore 15% of enemies' All-Attribute RES.

ranks.core:
Upon entering battle, Pyrois gains 30 <Term:1000018>Solar Prominence</Term>. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode. Landing different attacks on enemies grants a certain amount of <color=#FFFFFF>Solar Prominence</color>, and Pyrois also gains 0.5 <color=#FFFFFF>Solar Prominence</color> every second while in-combat, up to a max of 60.
When Pyrois uses different Ultimates, they gain the following effects:
Upper Branch - Ultimate: Total Annihilation: Gains 30 Solar Prominence and enters the <Term:1000019>Mirage</Term> state. While in the Mirage state, Pyrois' Ultimate deals 40% increased CRIT DMG against Stunned enemies, and with 30 or more Solar Prominence, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light. This effect lasts 21s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Lower Branch - Ultimate: Triumphant Return: Enters the <Term:1000020>Sunflare</Term> state. While in the Sunflare state, Energy Generation Rate increases by 15%, DMG dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>, and triggering a Perfect Block with an EX Special Attack grants 10 Solar Prominence. This effect lasts 200s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Left Branch - Ultimate: Unbound Swordstorm: When this skill's heavy attack hits an enemy in the Contamination state, it deals <color=#2BAD00>450%</color> of ATK as additional DMG.
Right Branch - Ultimate: Eternal Imprisonment: When this skill's heavy attack hits a Stunned enemy, the <Term:1000021>Totalize</Term> effect is triggered, dealing <color=#2BAD00>1,125%</color> of ATK as additional DMG. Upon activating this skill, the Stun duration of all currently Stunned enemies is extended by 3s. After landing the finishing move, the enemy's Stunned state ends.

velina.profileDesc:
Velina, the Administrative Director of the External Strategy Department, oversees cooperation and diplomacy between Roscaelifer and New Eridu.

As a descendant of the prestigious Airgid family, Velina inherited a strict and meticulous upbringing. Renowned for her nearly flawless efficiency and exceptional ability to keep any situation under control, she is the dependable adult whom Chief Technician Norma describes as someone capable of "handling meetings, paperwork, and troublesome people."

She is sharp and efficient in her work, meticulous, and always gentle and composed when dealing with others. Beneath her elegant, effortless smile lies an intensity that is impossible to ignore. No matter how troublesome the diplomatic affair or absurd the disaster may be, Velina can resolve it with ease. However, the price of seeking her help is not always one the requester can afford.

Velina has a particular fondness for all kinds of black tea and often invites friends to tea parties during her spare time.

Please note: Any tea party invitation sent by Velina in her capacity as Administrative Director should never be taken lightly. They are rarely mere leisure. More often, they serve as the perfect setting for her to negotiate situations and quietly steer events toward her desired outcome.

ranks.core:
When Velina's initial Energy Regen exceeds 1.2, every additional 0.01 increases DMG dealt by 0.21%, up to a maximum increase of 35%, and increases Anomaly Mastery by 0.5, up to a maximum increase of 84.
When Velina enters the battlefield, she gains 45 <Term:1000008>Windbloom</Term>. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s. Using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Purifying Rise</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Triple Deathblow</color> grants 45 <color=#FFFFFF>Windbloom</color>, up to a maximum of 135 <color=#FFFFFF>Windbloom</color>. 
When Velina triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color>, she gains 1 point of <Term:1000014>Windbite</Term> and summons a <Term:1000015>Condensed Cyclone</Term>, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>. This effect can trigger once every 3s. When Velina has 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbite</color>, the next time she triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color>, 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbite</color> are consumed to increase that <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color>'s DMG Multiplier by <color=#2BAD00>90%</color>. In addition, a <Term:1000016>Sweeping Cyclone</Term> is summoned instead of a <color=#FFFFFF>Condensed Cyclone</color>, which does not grant <color=#FFFFFF>Windbite</color>.
When Velina's summoned <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> hits an enemy suffering <color=#FFFFFF>Contamination</color> for the first time, it triggers <Term:1000017>Chromatic Tint</Term>, converting it into a <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> of the corresponding attribute, dealing the corresponding attribute's DMG. When <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> hits an enemy, the enemy's <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Anomaly Buildup RES</color> is reduced by 7% for 35s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. If a <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> enhanced by <color=#FFFFFF>Chromatic Tint</color> hits an enemy, the enemy's corresponding <color=#FFFFFF>Attribute Anomaly Buildup RES</color> is also reduced by 7% for 35s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
When an enemy affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> is defeated, the duration of that <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> is extended by 5s. This effect can only trigger once for the same <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color>, and only one <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> can exist at a time.
<color=#FFFFFF>Condensed Cyclone</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> trigger an explosion when they dissipate. If this explosion hits an enemy suffering a <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Anomaly</color>, it triggers one instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG against the target: resolves an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG, dealing a fixed <color=#2BAD00>85%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>135%</color> multiplier <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Anomaly DMG</color> respectively.
ranks.ability:

When squad members deal <color=#A6C5FD>Windswept</color> DMG, 20% of the target's <color=#A6C5FD>Wind RES</color> is ignored.

2.name: Saturation Project
2.desc: When Velina triggers <color=#A6C5FD>Windswept</color>, she can also gain 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbite</color>. This effect can trigger once every 5s. When Velina hits an enemy suffering a <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Attribute Anomaly</color>, the <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Attribute Anomaly Buildup</color> she inflicts increases by 20%. When Velina inflicts <color=#A6C5FD>Windswept</color> on an enemy already affected by <color=#A6C5FD>Windswept</color>, the new <color=#A6C5FD>Windswept</color>'s DMG increases based on the remaining duration of the previous. norma.profileDesc:
Norma, Chief Technician of the External Strategy Department and a central figure within Marcel Group's technological center. No matter how long or complicated her titles may sound, the young Miss Norma is without question a titan in the field of Bangboo technology. Even Lady Sunbringer herself may not understand every gear and chip inside a Bangboo body better than Norma does.

She fits every stereotype people have about genius scientists: her engineering skills are exceptional, while her people skills are inversely proportional. She takes Velina's "Etiquette Manual" seriously, and is equally serious about never following it.

A firm believer in performance above all, she was once feared by Bangboo due to her radical Bangboo modification techniques and somewhat less-than-Bangboo-centered approach, earning a reputation as a terrifying scientist who would stop at nothing for her research. ...The safety engineers at the External Strategy Department lab may share a similar view.

It's less that the title of "Chief Technician" crowned Norma in the field of Bangboo technology, and more that Norma herself represents the pinnacle of the Marcel Group's technological achievements.

remielle.profileDesc:
Remielle Dan, one of the first-generation Void Hunters, was formerly a Lieutenant Colonel in the Guard of Staves and currently a member of the secret organization known as the Covenant of Dayat.
Records describe her as a prodigy from childhood, capable of rapidly acquiring knowledge and mastering skills in nearly any discipline.
She was selected to join the Guard of Staves at a remarkably young age, was promoted directly to Lieutenant Colonel, and inherited the Void Hunter weapon, "Thaumiel." Fighting alongside Colonel Vike and the leader of the Falkenhayn Mercenary Troupe, she helped drive back the Dark Wall, rose to fame through that decisive battle, and was formally awarded the title of Void Hunter.
During the classified operation later known as the Day of Silence, Remielle and Colonel Vike were both believed to have been killed in action following an unexpected incident. Yet as she's still alive, then the truth must be something else entirely.
Remielle comes and goes without a trace, yet always seems to appear at the most unexpected, pivotal moments, steering events in a new direction.
Around others, Remielle always wears a sweet, effortless smile. Calm under any circumstances and almost disarmingly friendly, she rarely gives people a reason to raise their guard.
She excels at closing the distance with lighthearted banter, yet instinctively maintains just the right amount of distance, making her difficult to read.
Note: Remielle has a habit of playfully teasing those around her. As for you, you seem to receive a particularly generous share of that "special treatment."

1.name: Naive Oath
1.desc: Upon entering the battlefield, Remielle gains 3 special <Term:1000033></Term>s. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s. When Remielle triggers <Term:1000034></Term> to deal DMG, she ignores 50% of the target's All-Attribute RES. When using <color=#FFFFFF>Assist: Flower & Feather Dance</color>, she gains 200 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 18s. While Remielle is in the <Term:1000035></Term> state, other squad members' Attribute Anomaly DMG increases by 10%.

2.name: Fall Into the Noise
2.desc: Remielle's <color=#FFA9DD>Refringe Coefficient</color> increases by 20%. When an <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> character in the squad deals Anomaly DMG to an enemy affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Prismatic</color>, the attack ignores 15% of the target's DEF. This effect persists for an additional 8s after <color=#FFFFFF>Prismatic</color> ends. While Remielle is in the <Term:1000035></Term> state, the frequency at which she automatically attacks to apply <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux Buildup</color> to enemies increases.

4.name: The Long Goodbye
4.desc: When Remielle triggers <Term:1000034></Term>, the DMG multiplier is increased by an additional 12%. After entering the battlefield and gaining 3 special <Term:1000033></Term>s, if all <color=#FFFFFF>Voidflares</color> are consumed, she immediately gains the maximum number of special <color=#FFFFFF>Voidflares</color> again. This effect to regain special <color=#FFFFFF>Voidflares</color> is removed after being triggered once or when Remielle enters the <Term:1000035></Term> state.

6.name: Lone Feather's Endless Flight
6.desc: When Remielle uses <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Rainbow's End</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace</color>, <Term:1000034></Term> is triggered 2 times. If the 4th hit of her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> lands against a target, Remielle gains 3 special <color=#FFFFFF>Voidflares</color> after the skill ends. Special <Term:1000033></Term>s gained this way deal DMG equal to 25% of the special <color=#FFFFFF>Voidflares</color> gained upon entering the battlefield.

sigrid.profileDesc:
Sigrid de L'Azur, the current Deputy Administrative Director of the Airspace Patrol Department, trusted adjutant to Lindverne Sunbringer, and heir apparent to House de L'Azur, one of Roscaelifer's most prestigious noble families.

Like all those legendary figures, Sigrid has a long, long string of titles attached to her name. Yet even now, after serving for years as the Airspace Patrol Department's Deputy Administrative Director and earning top annual performance honors time and again, she still finds herself wondering whether she's truly worthy of the legendary hero "Sigrid" spoken of throughout the streets of Roscaelifer.

You can't exactly blame Sigrid for lacking confidence. After all, when the stories claim she can "stand shoulder to shoulder with a Void Hunter," "smash a building apart with one hand," or "blast straight through a Hollow with a single stab of her spear," any honest and sensible warrior would question whether they could truly achieve such feats with the weapon in their hand.

There is, however, one legend Sigrid has never doubted: "So long as my spear remains unbroken, the miracle of the skies shall never end."

kit.abilityName: Additional Ability: Legion of the Skies

ranks.core:
The 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear</color>, as well as <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Scattered Jade</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Shattered Jade</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Devouring Frost</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Encroaching Ice</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Frozen Heavens</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Counterthrust</color> are considered <Term:1000029></Term> attacks.
Whenever Sigrid uses and hits an enemy with any <Term:1000029></Term> while not in the <Term:1000030></Term> state, she enters the <Term:1000030></Term> state and gains 1 use of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color> that cannot be stacked.
While in the <Term:1000030></Term> state, when Sigrid hits an enemy with an <Term:1000029></Term> skill, the <Term:1000030></Term> state is refreshed and she gains 1 use of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color> that cannot be stacked.
When triggering or refreshing <Term:1000030></Term>, its duration decreases as the stage of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color> increases. At stage 1/2/3, its duration is <color=#FFFFFF>8</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>7</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>6</color>s.
When <Term:1000030></Term> ends, the stage of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color> is reduced by one, to a minimum of stage 1.
Activating or refreshing <Term:1000030></Term> increases Sigrid's CRIT Rate by <color=#2BAD00>33%</color> for <color=#FFFFFF>8</color>s. Repeated triggers extend the duration by <color=#FFFFFF>8</color>s, up to a maximum of <color=#FFFFFF>40</color>s.
When Sigrid hits a Stunned enemy while in <Term:1000030></Term>, the Stun DMG Multiplier of her DMG dealt to the target is increased by 20%.
